site.anchor: mediante concurso de duas ou mais pessoas (art. 155, § 4º, IV)
provisions: every "concurso de duas ou mais pessoas"

source.quote: IV - mediante concurso de duas ou mais pessoas.

citations.cite: CP art. 29 — "Quem, de qualquer modo, concorre para o crime"

readings.description: Everyone who took part counts, the agent included, whether or not each is punishable (a minor, a person not imputable) and whether or not each is identified.

citations.cite: CP art. 29; art. 155, § 4º, IV — "pessoas", not "agentes puníveis"

readings.description: Only those present at the execution count, not an instigator or a helper who stayed away.

citations.cite: CP art. 155, § 4º, IV — "mediante" the concurso, read as the manner of executing

taken.rationale: The field counts everyone who took part, and its herald says so; the fact supplier bears the convention.

site.anchor: as opções do juiz pelo art. 155, § 2º

source.quote: o juiz pode substituir a pena de reclusão pela de detenção, diminuí-la de um a dois terços, ou aplicar somente a pena de multa.

readings.description: Once the requirements are met the judge must grant the privilege, choosing among the three options.

citations.cite: STJ, HC 583.023/SC (j. 4.8.2020), as reported by secondary sources: "Trata-se, em verdade, de direito subjetivo do réu, não configurando mera faculdade do julgador a sua concessão"

readings.description: "O juiz pode": the judge may grant the privilege or not.

taken.rationale: Recorded, not built in: the encoding returns the three options when the requirements are met and states neither that one must be granted nor that none may be. It is named `as opções`, not `as faculdades`, so as not to take the rejected side.

notes: A second question sits under the same words: whether two options may be combined (substitution AND reduction). The text joins them with "ou"; the encoding returns the list and leaves the combination to the judge.
The STJ quotation is from a secondary compilation; g3's sweep should confirm it.

site.anchor: a pena cominada com a causa
provisions: every cause whose words name "as penas"

source.quote: As penas aplicam-se cumulativamente e em dobro

citations.cite: CP art. 58 — "A multa, prevista em cada tipo legal de crime, tem os limites fixados no art. 49 e seus parágrafos deste Código."

readings.description: A cause of increase or decrease changes the custodial range only. The fine a preceito prescribes has no number of its own to scale: art. 58 gives every multa art. 49's limits, and the judge fixes the number of dias-multa under arts. 49 and 60.

citations.cite: CP art. 60 — "Na fixação da pena de multa o juiz deve atender, principalmente, à situação econômica do réu."

readings.description: Where the paragraph's words reach the fine as well ("As penas aplicam-se … em dobro", plural, in a paragraph that also makes the fine cumulative), the increase applies to the number of dias-multa too.

citations.cite: CP art. 146, § 1º — "As penas aplicam-se cumulativamente e em dobro"

taken.rationale: For the shared machinery only: `a pena cominada com a causa` and `o intervalo com a causa` scale durations, and `Cominação da multa` is a conjunction, not a number. This does not decide the question for an article whose words reach the fine; PLAN § 2.2.1 hands it to that article's encoder (art. 146 § 1º is g2b's), who takes a reading there. g0 searched no authority on it, so no court's view is claimed either way.

site.anchor: o último dia do prazo em dias
provisions: every period the Code states in days

source.quote: Contam-se os dias, os meses e os anos pelo calendário comum.

readings.description: A period the Code states in days is that many calendar days, the first day counting: 180 days begun on 5 July 2026 end on 31 December 2026.

citations.cite: CP art. 10 — "Contam-se os dias, os meses e os anos pelo calendário comum."

readings.description: A period in days is converted at thirty days to the month and counted as calendar months, so 180 days begun on 5 July 2026 end on 4 January 2027. This is what `o último dia do prazo` did when given `dias 180`, before this fork was opened.
readings.rejection_rationale: Art. 10 counts days, months and years each on the calendar; it converts none into another. The thirty-day month is a convention for taking a FRACTION of a quantity (F-g0-03), and nothing in art. 10 extends it to counting a period. Found by g6b (art. 359-G's 180 days), 2026-09-29.

taken.rationale: `o último dia do prazo em dias` n d counts n calendar days from d, the first day counting, dropping a fraction of a day (art. 11). `Duração` is unchanged, because a second field would break every `Duração WITH` built elsewhere and would make `dias 20 EQUALS meses 2/3`-style assertions false; so a Duração does not remember its unit, and `o último dia do prazo` keeps counting its whole months on the calendar and the remainder as days, byte-identical for every period built from `anos` or `meses`.

notes: Not decided here: a quantity that DOSIMETRY produces in days (fifteen days doubled is thirty) is a Duração, and `o último dia do prazo` counts it as one calendar month. Whether a penalty fixed as 'trinta dias' is served as thirty days or as a month is F-g0-03's question on the other side, and is left open for the executing encoder (g1b/g1c).
witnesses: `o último dia do prazo em dias` 180 (YMD 2026 7 5) against `o último dia do prazo` (dias 180) (YMD 2026 7 5) — 31.12.2026 against 4.1.2027 (cp-g0-pena-testes.l4, § Art. 10)

site.anchor: o dia que fixa a lei aplicável (art. 4º; Súmula 711 STF)

source.quote: Art. 4º - Considera-se praticado o crime no momento da ação ou omissão, ainda que outro seja o momento do resultado.

readings.description: The law in force when the continuation or permanence ceases governs the whole, even if more severe, provided it came into force before the cessation.
Art. 2º's lex mitior and art. 4º's 'momento da ação' fix the law at the first act, so a later, more severe law does not reach the conduct.
readings.rejection_rationale: STF Súmula 711 holds the more severe law applicable where its vigência precedes the cessation of the continuity or permanence.

taken.rationale: Settled by the STF's súmula. The `Fato no tempo` record carries `data da cessação da permanência ou da continuidade`; where it is present, `o dia que fixa a lei aplicável (art. 4º; Súmula 711 STF)` returns it, and `a lei do tempo do crime (art. 4º)` is the law in force that day.

settled_by.citation: Súmula 711: "A LEI PENAL MAIS GRAVE APLICA-SE AO CRIME CONTINUADO OU AO CRIME PERMANENTE, SE A SUA VIGÊNCIA É ANTERIOR À CESSAÇÃO DA CONTINUIDADE OU DA PERMANÊNCIA."

witnesses: cp-g1a-aplicacao-testes.l4: `o crime permanente que atravessou a lei nova` (begun 1.12.2014, ceased 1.2.2015) is governed by `a lei mais severa de 2015`; the same succession for an instantaneous crime on 1.12.2014 by the law of 2000
notes: Reserved id: sweep-a's M-sweep-a-16 opened this fork (sweep-a.forks-proposed.json). It spans arts. 2, 4 and 71; g1a owns the lowest-numbered article and creates it here. g1b, which encodes art. 71, cross-refers to it.
The same day governs art. 1º's question (was there a law defining the fact?) for a permanent crime that began before the incriminating law and went on after it.

entries.delegated_field: Execução do crime's `a preparação do flagrante pela polícia tornou impossível a consumação` (and `havia vigilância ou segurança no local`, deliberately not read), in cp-g1a-crime.l4

site.anchor: crime impossível (art. 17)

source.quote: Art. 17 - Não se pune a tentativa quando, por ineficácia absoluta do meio ou por absoluta impropriedade do objeto, é impossível consumar-se o crime.

readings.description: A flagrante prepared by the police so that consummation is impossible is no crime; mere surveillance (electronic monitoring, security staff) does not by itself make the crime impossible.
Art. 17 reaches only absolute inefficacy of the means or absolute impropriety of the object; police preparation is outside it.
readings.rejection_rationale: STF Súmula 145 holds that there is no crime where the police's preparation of the flagrante makes consummation impossible.

readings.description: Any surveillance that would inevitably stop the theft makes it impossible within art. 17.
readings.rejection_rationale: STJ Súmula 567: surveillance or security staff inside a shop does not, by itself, make theft impossible.

taken.rationale: Settled by the two súmulas. Whether the preparation made consummation impossible is a finding on the facts; `crime impossível (art. 17)` reads it as a third limb beside the means and the object, and does not read the surveillance field at all, so surveillance alone never sets it.

settled_by.citation: Súmula 145: "NÃO HÁ CRIME, QUANDO A PREPARAÇÃO DO FLAGRANTE PELA POLÍCIA TORNA IMPOSSÍVEL A SUA CONSUMAÇÃO." (read with STJ Súmula 567 on surveillance, M-sweep-a-19)

witnesses: cp-g1a-crime-testes.l4: `o flagrante preparado` is a crime impossível; `o furto no mercado vigiado` is not, and its attempt is punishable
notes: Reserved id: sweep-a's M-sweep-a-18 opened it, with M-sweep-a-19; sweep-b's M-sweep-b-33 (Súmula 567 at art. 155) is subsumed by it.

site.anchor: as leis posteriores ao crime (art. 2º)
provisions: CP art. 2º, caput e parágrafo único

source.quote: A lei posterior, que de qualquer modo favorecer o agente, aplica-se aos fatos anteriores, ainda que decididos por sentença condenatória transitada em julgado.

readings.description: Any law that came into force after the crime counts as 'lei posterior', including one that was itself revoked before the decision (the lei intermediária): a milder one reaches the fact, and one that stopped treating it as a crime abolished it for good.
Only the law in force when the case is decided is compared with the law of the time; an intermediate law no longer in force has no effect.
readings.rejection_rationale: The text asks only that the law be later than the fact ('fatos anteriores'), not that it still be in force; the parágrafo único reaches facts already decided by a final judgment, so the comparison is not tied to the moment of decision.

taken.rationale: `as leis posteriores ao crime (art. 2º)` takes every law whose vigência began after the day that fixes the law and no later than the day of the decision, whatever its end.

witnesses: cp-g1a-aplicacao-testes.l4: `a lei intermediária mais branda` (2012–2014) reaches a fact of 2010 decided in 2020; `a lei intermediária abolicionista` abolished it

site.anchor: as leis posteriores mais favoráveis (art. 2º, parágrafo único)

source.quote: A lei posterior, que de qualquer modo favorecer o agente, aplica-se aos fatos anteriores

readings.description: The judge compares whole laws and applies the more favourable one entire; favourable parts of the later law may not be combined with favourable parts of the earlier one.

citations.cite: STJ, Súmula 501 (Terceira Seção, j. 23.10.2013, DJe 28.10.2013): "... desde que o resultado da incidência das suas disposições, na íntegra, seja mais favorável ao réu ..., sendo vedada a combinação de leis."

readings.description: 'De qualquer modo favorecer' lets the judge take the favourable provisions of each law and combine them.
readings.rejection_rationale: STJ Súmula 501: combining laws is forbidden, since it would create a third norm neither legislature enacted.

citations.cite: CP art. 2º, parágrafo único — "de qualquer modo"

taken.rationale: The encoding compares laws only through the judge's finding on each whole law (`favorece o agente em relação à lei do tempo do crime, segundo o juiz`) and returns whole laws, never parts. Where several later laws favour the agent it lists them all; which is the most favourable is the judge's comparison.

settled_by.authority: Superior Tribunal de Justiça, Terceira Seção
settled_by.citation: Súmula 501: "É cabível a aplicação retroativa da Lei n. 11.343/2006, desde que o resultado da incidência das suas disposições, na íntegra, seja mais favorável ao réu do que o advindo da aplicação da Lei n. 6.368/1976, sendo vedada a combinação de leis."

notes: The súmula's text is about the drug law of 2006, and states the general rule in its last clause. It was read in a secondary compilation (Trilhante) on 2026-09-29; the STJ's own archive page answered HTTP 403. The sweep (sweep-a) did not list it; the conductor may want sweep-a to record it as an interpretive entry.
Divergence 'none': the encoding has no way to express a combination, so the demoted reading cannot be exhibited.

site.anchor: a lei excepcional ou temporária rege o fato praticado durante sua vigência (art. 3º)

source.quote: Art. 3º - A lei excepcional ou temporária, embora decorrido o período de sua duração ou cessadas as circunstâncias que a determinaram, aplica-se ao fato praticado durante sua vigência.

readings.description: The exceptional or temporary law governs the facts of its period after it lapses; its lapse is no abolitio (art. 2º, caput), and the ordinary regime after it is no 'lei posterior mais favorável' (art. 2º, parágrafo único).

citations.cite: CP art. 3º — "embora decorrido o período de sua duração ... aplica-se ao fato praticado durante sua vigência"

readings.description: The Constitution's 'a lei penal não retroagirá, salvo para beneficiar o réu' (CF art. 5º, XL) admits no exception, so a milder later law reaches even the facts of a temporary law.
readings.foreclosure: The Code's own text says the opposite and no ruling of the STF or STJ displacing art. 3º was found by the sweep; the encoding follows the text.

taken.rationale: Art. 3º is written to override art. 2º for exactly this case; without it a temporary law would be unenforceable after it lapsed. `abolitio criminis (art. 2º, caput)` and `as leis posteriores mais favoráveis (art. 2º, parágrafo único)` both except the fact whose law of the time was exceptional or temporary.

witnesses: cp-g1a-aplicacao-testes.l4: `o fato durante a lei temporária` (June 2020) is governed by `a lei temporária de 2020` in 2022, though `o regime comum de 2021` no longer makes it a crime

site.anchor: a bordo, aplica-se a lei brasileira (art. 5º)

source.quote: bem como as aeronaves e as embarcações brasileiras, mercantes ou de propriedade privada, que se achem, respectivamente, no espaço aéreo correspondente ou em alto-mar.

citations.cite: CP art. 5º, § 2º — "em vôo no espaço aéreo correspondente"

readings.description: In § 1º, 'respectivamente' pairs the aircraft with 'o espaço aéreo correspondente' and the vessels with 'alto-mar', so the airspace is the one over the high seas. In § 2º, the same words mean the airspace over the national territory.
'Espaço aéreo correspondente' in § 1º is the airspace over the national territory, as in § 2º.
readings.rejection_rationale: A Brazilian aircraft in Brazil's airspace is already in the national territory (caput); the extension in § 1º would add nothing, and the high-seas airspace, which only § 1º could reach, would be left out.

taken.rationale: `Onde se encontrava` has distinct members for the airspace over the high seas and over Brazil, and the rule pairs each with the craft the text names.

witnesses: cp-g1a-aplicacao-testes.l4: a Brazilian private aircraft `no espaço aéreo correspondente ao alto-mar` is under Brazilian law; one `em território estrangeiro` is not

site.anchor: o efeito da pena cumprida no estrangeiro (art. 8º)

source.quote: Art. 8º - A pena cumprida no estrangeiro atenua a pena imposta no Brasil pelo mesmo crime, quando diversas, ou nela é computada, quando idênticas.

readings.description: 'Idênticas' means of the same kind among art. 32's three (custodial, restrictive of rights, fine): a custodial sentence served abroad is deducted from a custodial one imposed here.
'Idênticas' requires the same species of custodial penalty (reclusão against reclusão); a detenção served abroad only attenuates a reclusão imposed here.
readings.rejection_rationale: Foreign law does not use art. 33's species, so the comparison could rarely be made; a deduction of time served is what 'computada' asks for, and time is time.

readings.description: 'Idênticas' means the same penalty in kind and quantity.
readings.rejection_rationale: If the quantities had to be equal, 'computada' would always leave nothing to serve, and the paragraph would not need two words.

taken.rationale: `Pena cumprida no estrangeiro` records each side's `Espécie de pena` (cp-pena's art. 32 enum), and the rule compares them.

witnesses: cp-g1a-aplicacao-testes.l4: two years of custody served abroad against five imposed here leave three; custody against a restrictive penalty attenuates, and the rule refuses to compute by how much

site.anchor: a situação de legítima defesa (art. 25)
provisions: CP art. 25, caput e parágrafo único

source.quote: Art. 25 - Entende-se em legítima defesa quem, usando moderadamente dos meios necessários, repele injusta agressão, atual ou iminente, a direito seu ou de outrem.

citations.cite: STF, ADPF 779, Plenário, acórdão de 1.8.2023, DOU 10.8.2023

readings.description: The reading-down binds the courts from the STF's decision, whatever the date of the fact: every decision on or after 1.8.2023 excludes the honour thesis. Before that date, how the thesis stood under the text alone is not encoded.

citations.cite: STF, ADPF 779 — interpretação conforme, erga omnes and binding (Lei 9.882/1999)

readings.description: The reading-down is treated like a harsher law: it reaches only facts on or after 1.8.2023.
readings.foreclosure: An interpretação conforme declares what the text, read with the Constitution, always meant; it is not a later law, and art. 2º's rules about later laws do not govern it. No ruling limiting ADPF 779 to later facts was found.

taken.rationale: Every rule that reads art. 25 takes `a data da decisão`; `a situação de legítima defesa (art. 25)` is FALSE for the honour thesis from 1.8.2023 and refuses by name before it. The L4 rule-version axis (`RULES EFFECTIVE DATE`) would express the same thing, but unpinned it needs a document TIMEZONE and reads the wall clock (probe, notes/g1a.md), so an explicit parameter was used.

witnesses: cp-g1a-ilicitude-testes.l4: `a honra invocada` is no situation of legítima defesa on 1.8.2023 and in 2024; on 31.7.2023 the rule refuses
notes: The arm date is the merits acórdão's, as sweep entry M-sweep-a-01 gives it. The sweep did not check whether a medida cautelar bound the courts earlier; if one did, only `a data da ADPF 779` changes.

entries.delegated_field: `Por que a execução iniciada não se consumou`'s members `o agente desistiu voluntariamente de prosseguir na execução` and `o agente impediu voluntariamente que o resultado se produzisse`, in cp-g1a-crime.l4

site.anchor: desistência voluntária (art. 15)

source.quote: Art. 15 - O agente que, voluntariamente, desiste de prosseguir na execução ou impede que o resultado se produza, só responde pelos atos já praticados.

citations.cite: CP art. 65, III, b — "por sua espontânea vontade"

readings.description: The desistance or prevention need be voluntary, the agent's own choice, even if someone else suggested it; it need not be spontaneous.

citations.cite: CP art. 65, III, b — "espontânea vontade", a different word where the Code wants spontaneity

readings.description: Only a desistance that arises from the agent alone, unprompted, benefits from art. 15.
readings.rejection_rationale: The Code says 'voluntariamente' here and 'espontânea vontade' in art. 65, III, b; it chose different words for different requirements.

taken.rationale: The finding is named with the Code's word 'voluntariamente'; the fact-finder certifies it. A desistance forced by an outside obstacle is not voluntary: that case is `por circunstâncias alheias à vontade do agente`, an attempt.

site.anchor: incide a diminuição do art. 16

source.quote: até o recebimento da denúncia ou da queixa, por ato voluntário do agente, a pena será reduzida de um a dois terços. (Redação dada pela Lei nº 7.209, de 11.7.1984)

readings.description: 'Até o recebimento' includes the day the charge is received.
The reparation must come before the receipt, so a reparation on the day of receipt is late.
readings.rejection_rationale: 'Até' marks a limit reached, not one excluded; the Code says 'antes' where it means before (e.g. art. 65, III, b, 'antes do julgamento').

citations.cite: CP art. 65, III, b — "antes do julgamento"

taken.rationale: The rule compares the reparation's day AT MOST the receipt's day.

witnesses: cp-g1a-crime-testes.l4: reparation on 1.8.2026 with the charge received on 1.8.2026 is in time; on 2.8.2026 it is not

entries.delegated_field: `Reparação do dano`'s `data da reparação do dano ou da restituição da coisa`, in cp-g1a-crime.l4

site.anchor: Reparação do dano

source.quote: reparado o dano ou restituída a coisa, até o recebimento da denúncia ou da queixa, por ato voluntário do agente, a pena será reduzida de um a dois terços. (Redação dada pela Lei nº 7.209, de 11.7.1984)

readings.description: 'Reparado o dano ou restituída a coisa' means the whole damage repaired, or the whole thing returned; a partial reparation does not open art. 16.
A partial reparation opens art. 16, the fraction of reduction following how much was repaired.
readings.foreclosure: The text states a completed fact ('reparado o dano'), not a degree; the range of one to two thirds is the judge's to place, but not a license for a partial reparation. Whether the courts admit the partial case was not searched.

taken.rationale: The field records the day the damage was FULLY repaired or the thing returned; its herald says so, and a partial reparation is recorded as none.

site.anchor: legítima defesa do agente de segurança pública (art. 25, parágrafo único)

source.quote: Parágrafo único. Observados os requisitos previstos no caput deste artigo, considera-se também em legítima defesa o agente de segurança pública que repele agressão ou risco de agressão a vítima mantida refém durante a prática de crimes.

citations.cite: CP art. 25, parágrafo único (incluído pela Lei nº 13.964/2019)

readings.description: The paragraph adds no case: it demands every requisite of the caput, so a security officer who repels an aggression against a hostage is in legítima defesa exactly when the caput already says so.

citations.cite: CP art. 25, parágrafo único — "Observados os requisitos previstos no caput deste artigo"

readings.description: 'Agressão ou risco de agressão' reaches a risk short of an imminent aggression, widening legítima defesa for security officers.
readings.foreclosure: The paragraph's opening words require the caput's requisites, among them an aggression 'atual ou iminente'; a risk that is not imminent does not meet them.

citations.cite: CP art. 25, parágrafo único — "agressão ou risco de agressão"

taken.rationale: The rule requires `legítima defesa (art. 25, caput)` as its first limb, so it can never hold without the caput. For the same reason it needs no vigência gate: it cannot make a pre-2020 fact worse, and it makes none better.

notes: Shown declaratory, not divergent: cp-g1a-ilicitude-testes.l4: the hostage case holds under the paragraph and under the caput; immoderate, it holds under neither

entries.delegated_field: `Situação de necessidade`'s `o agente provocou o perigo por sua vontade`, in cp-g1a-ilicitude.l4

site.anchor: há situação de necessidade (art. 24)

source.quote: que não provocou por sua vontade, nem podia de outro modo evitar, direito próprio ou alheio, cujo sacrifício, nas circunstâncias, não era razoável exigir-se. (Redação dada pela Lei nº 7.209, de 11.7.1984)

readings.description: 'Por sua vontade' bars only a danger the agent caused intentionally; one caused by negligence still allows estado de necessidade.
Any danger the agent caused, intentionally or by negligence, bars estado de necessidade.

taken.rationale: The field is named in the Code's words; the fact-finder decides whether a negligent provocation was 'por sua vontade'. The first reading is the one the words most directly carry, and the one the herald's wording suggests.

site.anchor: o efeito das excludentes de ilicitude (art. 23)

source.quote: Parágrafo único - O agente, em qualquer das hipóteses deste artigo, responderá pelo excesso doloso ou culposo.

readings.description: The agent answers only for an excess that was doloso or culposo; an excess with neither (an understandable overreaction the fact-finder attributes to neither intent nor negligence) is not punished.

citations.cite: CP art. 23, parágrafo único — "responderá pelo excesso doloso ou culposo"

readings.description: Once the limits are exceeded the justification fails entirely, and the agent answers for the crime as committed, whatever the modality of the excess.
readings.rejection_rationale: The paragraph confines liability to the doloso or culposo excess, and art. 18's parágrafo único punishes nothing without dolo or, where provided, culpa.

taken.rationale: `Modalidade do excesso` has only the doloso and culposo members; an excess with no modality found returns the named outcome `excesso sem dolo nem culpa, que o parágrafo único não pune (art. 23)`.

witnesses: cp-g1a-ilicitude-testes.l4: an immoderate defence with no modality found

site.anchor: as causas de diminuição cabíveis (arts. 26 e 28)

source.quote: A pena pode ser reduzida de um a dois terços, se o agente, em virtude de perturbação de saúde mental ou por desenvolvimento mental incompleto ou retardado não era inteiramente capaz de entender o caráter ilícito do fato ou de determinar-se de acordo com esse entendimento. (Redação dada pela Lei nº 7.209, de 11.7.1984)

readings.description: Once the requirements are met the reduction must be applied; the judge chooses only the fraction within the range.

citations.cite: CP art. 68 — the causes of decrease are applied in the third phase

readings.description: 'Pode'/'poderá': the judge may decline the reduction even when the requirements are met.

citations.cite: CP arts. 21, 24, § 2º, 26, parágrafo único, 28, § 2º, 29, § 1º — "pode", "poderá", against art. 16's "será"

taken.rationale: Recorded, not built in: the rules list each reduction as `cabível` (available) where its requirements are met and say nothing about whether the judge must apply it; the outcome names keep the Code's 'pode'. No authority was searched for any of the five articles; the question is left for a Brazilian criminal lawyer (notes/g1a.md).

notes: The same question g0 recorded for art. 155, § 2º (F-g0-27). The Code's own contrast is art. 16, 'será reduzida', encoded as mandatory.

site.anchor: o efeito do erro (art. 20)

source.quote: Não há isenção de pena quando o erro deriva de culpa e o fato é punível como crime culposo.

citations.cite: CP art. 20, caput — "exclui o dolo, mas permite a punição por crime culposo, se previsto em lei"

readings.description: A putative justification from an avoidable error is treated as an error on the tipo, like the caput whose paragraph it is: dolo is excluded, the culposo crime is punished where the law provides it, and where it does not, nothing is left to punish.

citations.cite: CP art. 20, caput and § 1º — the paragraph's second sentence names the consequence as punishment 'como crime culposo'

readings.description: An avoidable error on a justifying situation is an error on illicitude: the doloso crime stands, with art. 21's reduction.
readings.foreclosure: The paragraph's own sentence gives the culpable putative justification the culposo crime's punishment, which only the first reading explains; the second would punish it as doloso.

taken.rationale: `o efeito do erro (art. 20)` returns the named outcome `o erro deriva de culpa e o fato não é punível como crime culposo: não é punível (art. 20, § 1º, com o caput)`.

witnesses: cp-g1a-erro-testes.l4: a culpable putative defence where the crime has no culposo form

entries.delegated_field: `Coação ou ordem`'s `o fato foi cometido em estrita obediência a ordem de superior hierárquico`, in cp-g1a-erro.l4

site.anchor: só é punível o autor da coação ou da ordem (art. 22)

source.quote: em estrita obediência a ordem, não manifestamente ilegal, de superior hierárquico

citations.cite: CP art. 65, III, c — "em cumprimento de ordem de autoridade superior"

readings.description: 'Superior hierárquico' is a superior in the public administration's hierarchy; an employer, a parent or a religious superior is not one.
Any relation of subordination, private employment included, gives a 'superior hierárquico'.
readings.rejection_rationale: An order the subordinate must obey without questioning its legality exists only in public hierarchy; the parallel attenuation of art. 65, III, c speaks of 'autoridade superior'.

taken.rationale: The finding is named in the Code's words; the fact-finder certifies that the superior was a hierarchical one. 'Coação irresistível' is read as moral coercion; physical force leaves no act of the coerced at all, and the rule answers the same (only the coercer punishable), so that second question has no divergence and is not a fork of its own.

site.anchor: cabe a diminuição do art. 26, parágrafo único
provisions: CP art. 26, caput e parágrafo único

source.quote: em virtude de perturbação de saúde mental ou por desenvolvimento mental incompleto ou retardado

citations.cite: CP art. 26, caput — "por doença mental ou desenvolvimento mental incompleto ou retardado"

readings.description: The caput exempts only for mental illness or incomplete or retarded development with total incapacity. Every other impairment — a mental illness that left some capacity (a 'perturbação de saúde mental' in the wider sense), or a disturbance that is not an illness even if it took all capacity — is the parágrafo único's reduction.

citations.cite: CP art. 26, caput and parágrafo único, as worded

readings.description: The degree decides: total incapacity from any mental cause exempts under the caput; partial incapacity from any cause, mental illness included, is the parágrafo único's.

taken.rationale: The caput names two causes and the parágrafo único names 'perturbação de saúde mental', a wider term; the encoding keeps the caput to its two causes and reads the parágrafo único's term to include a mental illness of lesser effect. The readings agree except on a non-illness disturbance that took all capacity, which the taken reading leaves to the parágrafo único. A mental-health expert's classification of such a case as 'doença mental' would move it to the caput under either reading.

witnesses: cp-g1a-imputabilidade-testes.l4: `perturbação de saúde mental` with no capacity left gives the parágrafo único's reduction, not the caput's exemption

site.anchor: o crime chegou, pelo menos, a ser tentado (art. 31)

source.quote: se o crime não chega, pelo menos, a ser tentado. (Redação dada pela Lei nº 7.209, de 11.7.1984)

citations.cite: CP art. 14, II — "tentado, quando, iniciada a execução, não se consuma por circunstâncias alheias à vontade do agente"

readings.description: 'Tentado' is art. 14, II's defined word: a crime the executor gave up by his own will (art. 15) did not reach an attempt, so the agreement, incitement or help behind it is not punishable either.
The crime 'reached an attempt' once execution began; the executor's desistance is personal to him (art. 30) and does not help the participant.
readings.foreclosure: The Code defines 'tentado' in art. 14, II and uses the same word here; a crime abandoned by the agent's will is outside that definition.

taken.rationale: `o crime chegou, pelo menos, a ser tentado (art. 31)` is consummation or cp-pena's `crime tentado (art. 14, II)`. An impossible crime (art. 17) did reach an attempt in that sense; it is art. 17 that leaves it unpunished.

witnesses: cp-g1a-concurso-testes.l4: the lookout's help where the executor desisted is not punishable; the instigation of an impossible crime is not excused by art. 31

entries.delegated_field: `Concorrente`'s `participação de menor importância, segundo o juiz`, in cp-g1a-concurso.l4

site.anchor: cabe a diminuição do art. 29, § 1º

source.quote: § 1º - Se a participação for de menor importância, a pena pode ser diminuída de um sexto a um terço.

readings.description: 'Participação' is the participant's part (instigation, help), not the co-author's; a co-author cannot have a part of minor importance.
Any concorrente, co-authors included, may have had a part of minor importance.

citations.cite: CP art. 29, caput — "Quem, de qualquer modo, concorre"

taken.rationale: The finding is the judge's; the encoding does not compute it from the modes of concurring. Which reading the courts take was not searched; the question is listed for a Brazilian criminal lawyer.

site.anchor: a primeira pena é menos grave que a segunda

source.quote: Se algum dos concorrentes quis participar de crime menos grave, ser-lhe-á aplicada a pena deste; essa pena será aumentada até metade, na hipótese de ter sido previsível o resultado mais grave. (Redação dada pela Lei nº 7.209, de 11.7.1984)

readings.description: 'Menos grave' is measured by the penas cominadas: the smaller maximum, then the smaller minimum (F-g0-18's measure of the heavier).

citations.cite: CP art. 29, § 2º — "ser-lhe-á aplicada a pena deste"

readings.description: 'Menos grave' is judged on the crimes themselves (the interest injured, the manner), not only on their penalties.

taken.rationale: The paragraph's consequence is a penalty ('a pena deste'), so the comparison it presupposes is of penalties. The encoding measures as g0 did for the heaviest qualified form, and a crime of equal pena is not 'menos grave'.

witnesses: cp-g1a-concurso-testes.l4: `o comparsa que quis crime de igual pena` receives the pena of the crime committed
notes: The helper repeats F-g0-18's measure because g1a may not import g3's module; the conductor can merge them.

site.anchor: a circunstância se comunica aos demais concorrentes (art. 30)

source.quote: Art. 30 - Não se comunicam as circunstâncias e as condições de caráter pessoal, salvo quando elementares do crime.

readings.description: Art. 30 decides only whether the circumstance communicates; a participant who did not know of an elementary circumstance errs on an element of the tipo, and art. 20 excludes his dolo.
Art. 30 itself requires that the other participant knew of the elementary circumstance for it to communicate.

taken.rationale: Art. 30's words say nothing of knowledge; the Code already answers ignorance of an element in art. 20. Both readings give the same result for the participant.

site.anchor: crime cometido sem violência ou grave ameaça à pessoa (art. 16)

source.quote: Nos crimes cometidos sem violência ou grave ameaça à pessoa, reparado o dano ou restituída a coisa, até o recebimento da denúncia ou da queixa, por ato voluntário do agente, a pena será reduzida de um a dois terços. (Redação dada pela Lei nº 7.209, de 11.7.1984)

readings.description: The violence and grave threat that bar art. 16 are those used as the means of the conduct against a person; violence against a thing (a broken lock), a threat that is not grave, and an injury that results only from negligence do not bar it.

citations.cite: CP art. 16 — "cometidos sem violência ou grave ameaça à pessoa"

readings.description: Any violent result to a person, even a negligent one, bars art. 16.
readings.foreclosure: The text speaks of crimes 'cometidos sem violência', the manner of commission, not of their results. Whether the courts apply art. 16 to negligent crimes with a violent result was not searched.

taken.rationale: `crime cometido sem violência ou grave ameaça à pessoa (art. 16)` reads the shared `Fato`'s `meios empregados` for `violência à pessoa` and `grave ameaça`, and nothing else.

witnesses: cp-g1a-crime-testes.l4: `o furto com rompimento` and `a ameaça simples` admit the reduction; `o roubo com violência` and `o roubo com grave ameaça` do not

entries.delegated_field: `Situação de necessidade`'s `perigo atual`, in cp-g1a-ilicitude.l4

site.anchor: há situação de necessidade (art. 24)

source.quote: para salvar de perigo atual, que não provocou por sua vontade, nem podia de outro modo evitar, direito próprio ou alheio, cujo sacrifício, nas circunstâncias, não era razoável exigir-se. (Redação dada pela Lei nº 7.209, de 11.7.1984)

readings.description: Only a current danger opens estado de necessidade; the Code wrote 'atual ou iminente' in art. 25 and only 'atual' in art. 24.
An imminent danger is already a current one for art. 24's purpose, since waiting would defeat the rescue.

taken.rationale: The finding carries the Code's word 'atual'; whether an imminent danger is current is the fact-finder's to say. The contrast with art. 25 is recorded, not decided.

entries.delegated_field: `Crime cometido no estrangeiro`'s `o agente é brasileiro`, in cp-g1a-aplicacao.l4

site.anchor: hipótese do art. 7º, II

source.quote: b) praticados por brasileiro; (Incluído pela Lei nº 7.209, de 1984)

readings.description: Brazilian nationality (the agent's under II, b; the victim's under § 3º) is taken at the time of the crime (art. 4º).
Nationality acquired or lost after the crime counts, as of the time of the prosecution.

taken.rationale: The fields' heralds are read at the time of the crime, the Code's time of the crime being art. 4º's; the fact-supplier certifies the nationality then.

site.anchor: a segunda fase (arts. 61 a 67)

source.quote: Art. 65 - São circunstâncias que sempre atenuam a pena:

readings.description: The second-phase result is floored at the cominated minimum: atenuantes reduce towards it but not past it; symmetrically, agravantes stop at the maximum.
'Sempre atenuam' means always: an atenuante may take the penalty below the cominated minimum, which binds only the pena-base.
readings.rejection_rationale: Súmula 231 STJ holds the atenuante cannot take the penalty below the legal minimum.

taken.rationale: Settled by Súmula 231 STJ (M-sweep-a-09). The second phase is a range; its floor is the cominated minimum and its ceiling the maximum, the ceiling being the same reading applied to the agravantes.

settled_by.authority: Superior Tribunal de Justiça, Terceira Seção
settled_by.citation: Súmula 231: "A incidência da circunstância atenuante não pode conduzir à redução da pena abaixo do mínimo legal."

witnesses: cp-g1b-circunstancias-testes.l4: `a segunda fase (arts. 61 a 67)` with a pena-base at the minimum and an atenuante gives 2 to 2 years
notes: The ceiling for the agravantes is the same reading in mirror; no authority for it was fetched.

site.anchor: a valoração dos antecedentes é admissível

source.quote: Art. 61 - São circunstâncias que sempre agravam a pena, quando não constituem ou qualificam o crime:

readings.description: No: a conviction that makes the agent reincidente is weighed only in the second phase; it cannot also raise the pena-base. Where the agent has two such convictions, one may be the record and the other the reincidência.
Yes: art. 59 and art. 61 are independent and each may take the same conviction into account.
readings.rejection_rationale: Súmula 241 STJ forbids it.

taken.rationale: Settled by Súmula 241 STJ (M-sweep-a-10). Encoded per conviction: the valuation of the record is inadmissible when every conviction that generates reincidência was weighed as a bad record, since art. 61 makes the agravante apply "sempre".

settled_by.authority: Superior Tribunal de Justiça, Terceira Seção
settled_by.citation: Súmula 241: "A reincidência penal não pode ser considerada como circunstância agravante e, simultaneamente, como circunstância judicial."

witnesses: cp-g1b-aplicacao-da-pena-testes.l4: `admite-se valorar como antecedentes` "processo 1" with that conviction alone (FALSE) and "processo 9" beside "processo 1" (TRUE)
notes: That one of two reincidência-generating convictions may be the record and the other the agravante is the STJ practice as g1b understands it; no authority for that part was fetched.

site.anchor: a valoração dos antecedentes é admissível

source.quote: Art. 59 - O juiz, atendendo à culpabilidade, aos antecedentes, à conduta social, à personalidade do agente, aos motivos, às circunstâncias e conseqüências do crime, bem como ao comportamento da vítima, estabelecerá, conforme seja necessário e suficiente para reprovação e prevenção do crime:

readings.description: Only final convictions (final by the day of the sentence) count; there is no time limit on them; pending inquiries and prosecutions never count.
Art. 64, I's five-year purge applies to antecedentes by analogy.
readings.rejection_rationale: RE 593.818/SC: the five-year period does not apply to maus antecedentes.

readings.description: Pending inquiries and prosecutions are part of the agent's antecedentes.
readings.rejection_rationale: Súmula 444 STJ forbids it.

taken.rationale: Settled by RE 593.818/SC (M-sweep-a-12) and Súmula 444 STJ (M-sweep-a-11). The rule never consults art. 64 for the record, refuses pending inquiries, and accepts only convictions final by the sentence.

settled_by.citation: RE 593.818/SC: "Não se aplica ao reconhecimento dos maus antecedentes o prazo quinquenal de prescrição da reincidência, previsto no art. 64, I, do Código Penal."

witnesses: cp-g1b-aplicacao-da-pena-testes.l4: a conviction served in 2015 (purged from reincidência) admitted as a record; "processo 12", final after the sentence, refused; pending inquiries refused
notes: M-sweep-a-13 (Súmula 636 STJ, the criminal-record sheet suffices as proof) is a rule of proof; the encoding takes the convictions as input.

entries.interpretation_field: Leituras do concurso.o aumento segue a escala da Súmula 659 STJ

site.anchor: o aumento do crime continuado (art. 71)

source.quote: aplica-se-lhe a pena de um só dos crimes, se idênticas, ou a mais grave, se diversas, aumentada, em qualquer caso, de um sexto a dois terços.

readings.description: The Code gives a range; the fraction within it is the judge's, to be reasoned.
The fraction follows the number of offences: 1/6 for two, 1/5 for three, 1/4 for four, 1/3 for five, 1/2 for six, 2/3 for seven or more.

taken.rationale: Súmula 659 STJ (M-sweep-a-14) states the fraction the STJ requires; the Code's range stays the legal bound and runs as the other reading. The field is a BOOLEAN with TYPICALLY TRUE (TRUE is escalaPorNumeroDeCrimes, FALSE is faixaDoJuiz), and the named value `a leitura da Súmula 659 STJ` carries the same default.

settled_by.authority: Superior Tribunal de Justiça, Terceira Seção
settled_by.citation: Súmula 659: "A fração de aumento em razão da prática de crime continuado deve ser fixada de acordo com o número de delitos cometidos, aplicando-se 1/6 pela prática de duas infrações, 1/5 para três, 1/4 para quatro, 1/3 para cinco, 1/2 para seis e 2/3 para sete ou mais infrações."

witnesses: cp-g1b-concurso-de-crimes-testes.l4: three crimes of two years — 28.8 months under escalaPorNumeroDeCrimes, 28 to 40 months under faixaDoJuiz
notes: The field is a BOOLEAN, so the reading ids are not L4 constructors: escalaPorNumeroDeCrimes is TRUE and faixaDoJuiz is FALSE. It was first an enum with those two constructors; this binary rejects a TYPICALLY whose value is a constructor of one's own enum (notes/cp-g1b-sondas/cp-g1b-sonda-typically-enum.l4), so at the conductor's request (2026-09-30) it became a BOOLEAN, on which TYPICALLY is accepted.
A gloss on its own line below a TYPICALLY field is silently lost (cp-g1b-sonda-typically-boolean.l4); the field puts it between its name and its type (cp-g1b-sonda-typically-boolean-split.l4).

site.anchor: a pena que regula a prescrição do crime continuado (Súmula 497 STF)

source.quote: Art. 119 - No caso de concurso de crimes, a extinção da punibilidade incidirá sobre a pena de cada um, isoladamente.

readings.description: Prescription is governed by the penalty imposed for the crime, not counting the continuation increase.
Art. 71 treats the continued crimes as one, so the increased penalty is the one art. 110 measures.
readings.rejection_rationale: Súmula 497 STF.

taken.rationale: Settled by Súmula 497 STF (M-sweep-a-15). g1b exposes the penalty before the increase; the prescription itself is g1c's (arts. 109 to 119).

settled_by.citation: Súmula 497: "QUANDO SE TRATAR DE CRIME CONTINUADO, A PRESCRIÇÃO REGULA-SE PELA PENA IMPOSTA NA SENTENÇA, NÃO SE COMPUTANDO O ACRÉSCIMO DECORRENTE DA CONTINUAÇÃO."

witnesses: cp-g1b-concurso-de-crimes-testes.l4: `a pena que regula a prescrição do crime continuado (Súmula 497 STF)` gives two years where the continued penalty is more
notes: Created by g1b because art. 71 is the lowest-numbered provision; g1c (arts. 109–119) cross-refers to it and dropped its own copy (2026-09-30).
A second site, g1c's: cp-g1c-prescricao.l4, `a pena que regula a prescrição no crime continuado (Súmula 497 STF)` (art. 119).

site.anchor: a pena considerada para os benefícios (art. 75; Súmula 715 STF)

source.quote: § 1º Quando o agente for condenado a penas privativas de liberdade cuja soma seja superior a 40 (quarenta) anos, devem elas ser unificadas para atender ao limite máximo deste artigo.

readings.description: The ceiling limits time served; fractions for benefits are computed on the total penalty imposed.
The unified penalty replaces the total for every purpose, including the fractions of art. 83.
readings.rejection_rationale: Súmula 715 STF.

taken.rationale: Settled by Súmula 715 STF (M-sweep-a-20), whose "trinta anos" is the pre-2020 ceiling; its rule is not tied to the number.

settled_by.citation: Súmula 715: "A PENA UNIFICADA PARA ATENDER AO LIMITE DE TRINTA ANOS DE CUMPRIMENTO, DETERMINADO PELO ART. 75 DO CÓDIGO PENAL, NÃO É CONSIDERADA PARA A CONCESSÃO DE OUTROS BENEFÍCIOS, COMO O LIVRAMENTO CONDICIONAL OU REGIME MAIS FAVORÁVEL DE EXECUÇÃO."

witnesses: cp-g1b-concurso-de-crimes-testes.l4: thirty and fifteen years — unified to 40, benefits on 45
notes: Created by g1b because art. 75 is the lowest-numbered provision; g1c cross-refers to it at art. 84, whose fractions it computes on the sum of the penalties, never on art. 75's ceiling (message from g1c, 2026-09-30).

entries.delegated_field: Sentença.fundamentação concreta e idônea para regime mais gravoso

site.anchor: os regimes iniciais admissíveis (art. 33, §§ 2º e 3º)

source.quote: § 3º - A determinação do regime inicial de cumprimento da pena far-se-á com observância dos critérios previstos no art. 59 deste Código.

readings.description: A regime harsher than the penalty permits only on an idoneous, concrete reason from the art. 59 circumstances; the abstract gravity of the offence is never enough.
Art. 33, § 3º's reference to art. 59 lets the judge weigh the offence's gravity as such.
readings.rejection_rationale: Súmulas 718 and 719 STF, 440 STJ.

taken.rationale: Settled by Súmulas 718 and 719 STF and 440 STJ (M-sweep-a-21, M-sweep-a-22). The encoding computes the regime the penalty permits and admits a harsher one only where the sentence records a concrete, proper ground; whether a reason is idoneous is the judge's and cannot be computed.

settled_by.citation: Súmula 718: "A OPINIÃO DO JULGADOR SOBRE A GRAVIDADE EM ABSTRATO DO CRIME NÃO CONSTITUI MOTIVAÇÃO IDÔNEA PARA A IMPOSIÇÃO DE REGIME MAIS SEVERO DO QUE O PERMITIDO SEGUNDO A PENA APLICADA."

witnesses: cp-g1b-privativas-de-liberdade-testes.l4: four years of reclusão to a first offender — aberto alone without the ground, aberto to fechado with it

site.anchor: o regime inicial mais brando que a pena permite (art. 33, § 2º)

source.quote: b) o condenado não reincidente, cuja pena seja superior a 4 (quatro) anos e não exceda a 8 (oito), poderá, desde o princípio, cumpri-la em regime semi-aberto;

readings.description: At four years or less, the semi-aberto is admissible if the art. 59 circumstances are favourable; otherwise, and above four years, the harshest regime the species allows (for detenção, the semi-aberto).
Every reincidente starts in fechado: § 2º grants the milder regimes only to the não reincidente.
readings.rejection_rationale: Súmula 269 STJ admits the semi-aberto at four years or less.

taken.rationale: Settled by Súmula 269 STJ (M-sweep-a-23) for four years or less; above that the text's silence leaves the harshest regime the species allows, and art. 33's caput keeps detenção from starting closed (F-g1b-01).

settled_by.authority: Superior Tribunal de Justiça, Terceira Seção
settled_by.citation: Súmula 269: "É admissível a adoção do regime prisional semi-aberto aos reincidentes condenados a pena igual ou inferior a quatro anos se favoráveis as circunstâncias judiciais."

witnesses: cp-g1b-privativas-de-liberdade-testes.l4: a reincidente with four years — semi-aberto with favourable circumstances, fechado without

site.anchor: a confissão parcial ou qualificada atenua (art. 65, III, d)

source.quote: d) confessado espontaneamente, perante a autoridade, a autoria do crime;

readings.description: Any spontaneous confession attenuates, whether or not the judge relied on it; a partial or qualified confession attenuates in a smaller proportion.
The confession attenuates only if used to form the judge's conviction, and a qualified confession does not attenuate.

citations.cite: STJ, Súmulas 545 and 630 in their wording before 10/09/2025

readings.rejection_rationale: Both súmulas were revised on 10/09/2025.

taken.rationale: Settled by the revised Súmulas 545 and 630 STJ (M-sweep-a-24, M-sweep-a-25). A full and a partial or qualified confession are two atenuantes, so the judge can weigh the second less; the proportion is the judge's.

settled_by.authority: Superior Tribunal de Justiça, Terceira Seção (tema repetitivo 1194)
settled_by.citation: Súmula 545 (revised): "A confissão do autor possibilita a atenuação da pena prevista no art. 65, III, d, do Código Penal, independentemente de ser utilizada na formação do convencimento do julgador."

witnesses: cp-g1b-circunstancias-testes.l4: a partial confession gives `a confissão parcial ou qualificada (art. 65, III, d)`; with a full one, only the full

site.anchor: o regime inicial mais gravoso da espécie (art. 33, caput)

source.quote: A de detenção, em regime semi-aberto, ou aberto, salvo necessidade de transferência a regime fechado.

citations.cite: CP art. 33, § 2º, a — "o condenado a pena superior a 8 (oito) anos deverá começar a cumpri-la em regime fechado"

readings.description: Detenção starts in the semi-aberto or aberto; the closed regime is reached only by transfer, so a detenção over eight years starts in the semi-aberto.
§ 2º, a speaks of any penalty over eight years, so a detenção over eight years starts closed.
readings.rejection_rationale: The caput says what regimes detenção is served in and allows the closed one only by transfer; § 2º applies "observados" the species. Reading a as reaching detenção would make the caput's "salvo necessidade de transferência" idle.

taken.rationale: The caput states the regimes of each species; § 2º orders the start within them.

witnesses: cp-g1b-privativas-de-liberdade-testes.l4: detenção of nine years gives semi-aberto only
notes: No authority fetched; g1b believes this is also the courts' reading.

site.anchor: os regimes iniciais admissíveis (art. 33, §§ 2º e 3º)

source.quote: a) o condenado a pena superior a 8 (oito) anos deverá começar a cumpri-la em regime fechado;

readings.description: "pena" is the penalty applied in the sentence.
"pena" is the maximum the preceito prescribes.
readings.rejection_rationale: § 2º speaks of "o condenado a pena", the convict's penalty, and art. 59, III fixes the regime in the sentence after the quantity (II).

taken.rationale: The regime is fixed in the sentence after the quantity; in concurso, the sum the execution unifies is the Lei de Execução Penal's (art. 111), outside the source.

site.anchor: as circunstâncias judiciais são favoráveis

source.quote: § 3º - A determinação do regime inicial de cumprimento da pena far-se-á com observância dos critérios previstos no art. 59 deste Código.

citations.cite: STJ, Súmula 269 — "se favoráveis as circunstâncias judiciais"

readings.description: The circumstances are favourable when none of the eight was valued against the accused; neutral ones do not count against.
Every one of the eight must be valued favourable.
readings.rejection_rationale: Art. 59's circumstances are often not valued either way; requiring all to be positively favourable would make the súmula almost never apply.

taken.rationale: The judge values each circumstance favourable, neutral or unfavourable; only an unfavourable one weighs against.

witnesses: cp-g1b-privativas-de-liberdade-testes.l4: `circunstâncias neutras` favourable; one unfavourable (the record) not
notes: The three-valued valuation (favorável, neutra, desfavorável) is the judge's vocabulary for art. 59, not an epistemic status.

site.anchor: os dias de custódia do período (art. 42)

source.quote: Art. 42 - Computam-se, na pena privativa de liberdade e na medida de segurança, o tempo de prisão provisória, no Brasil ou no estrangeiro, o de prisão administrativa e o de internação em qualquer dos estabelecimentos referidos no artigo anterior.

citations.cite: CP art. 10 — "O dia do começo inclui-se no cômputo do prazo."

readings.description: Every day in custody counts whole, the first and the last included.
The time is the difference between the last and the first day.
readings.rejection_rationale: A day spent in custody is a day of the penalty served; art. 10 includes the first day.

taken.rationale: Art. 10 counts the first day; a day in custody is a day served.

witnesses: cp-g1b-privativas-de-liberdade-testes.l4: 1 to 30 April 2026 is 30 days; a single day is 1
notes: The days credited become a Duração in the dosimetry's 30-day convention (F-g0-03) and are subtracted from the penalty; no calendar end date is computed, so cp-pena's day-period defect in `o último dia do prazo` does not reach it.

entries.delegated_field: Crime em julgamento.classificações (crime contra a administração pública)

site.anchor: a progressão depende da reparação do dano (art. 33, § 4º)

source.quote: § 4o O condenado por crime contra a administração pública terá a progressão de regime do cumprimento da pena condicionada à reparação do dano que causou, ou à devolução do produto do ilícito praticado, com os acréscimos legais.

readings.description: "crime contra a administração pública" is a crime of Título XI of the Parte Especial.

citations.cite: CP Parte Especial, Título XI — "Dos crimes contra a administração pública"

readings.description: Any crime that injures the public administration, wherever defined.
readings.foreclosure: The Code names a Título with the same words; a wider reading needs an authority, and none was fetched.

taken.rationale: The phrase is the heading of Título XI; the crime record carries the classification, supplied by the offence's encoder or the court.

site.anchor: o inciso I do art. 44 está satisfeito

source.quote: I – aplicada pena privativa de liberdade não superior a quatro anos e o crime não for cometido com violência ou grave ameaça à pessoa ou, qualquer que seja a pena aplicada, se o crime for culposo;

readings.description: Two alternatives: (four years or less and no violence) or (culposo, any penalty); the violence bar does not reach the culposo limb.
The violence bar governs both limbs.
readings.rejection_rationale: "qualquer que seja a pena aplicada, se o crime for culposo" is set off as its own alternative with its own condition; a culposo crime is not "cometido com violência" in the intentional sense the bar addresses.

taken.rationale: The punctuation sets the culposo limb apart.

witnesses: cp-g1b-restritivas-de-direitos-testes.l4: a culposo crime with violence and six years admits substitution

site.anchor: o crime foi cometido com violência ou grave ameaça à pessoa

source.quote: o crime não for cometido com violência ou grave ameaça à pessoa

readings.description: Violence against a person or a serious threat, as the shared means record them.
Also reducing the victim to impotence by other means (violência imprópria, as in art. 157).

citations.cite: CP art. 157, caput — "ou depois de havê-la, por qualquer meio, reduzido à impossibilidade de resistência"

readings.foreclosure: Art. 157 names that means beside violence, as a different thing; no authority settling art. 44 was fetched.

taken.rationale: Art. 157 distinguishes the two means, which suggests "violência" alone does not include the other; the narrower reading also favours the accused.

witnesses: cp-g1b-restritivas-de-direitos-testes.l4: reduction to impotence does not bar substitution
notes: M-sweep-a-39 (Súmula 588 STJ, violence or grave threat against a woman at home) is subsumed in this limb for crimes of the Code.

site.anchor: as condenações que fazem o réu reincidente em crime doloso (art. 44, II)

source.quote: II – o réu não for reincidente em crime doloso;

readings.description: Reincidente between two dolosos: the new crime is doloso and an earlier conviction generating reincidência was for a doloso.
The new crime is doloso and the agent is reincidente by any earlier crime.
readings.foreclosure: No authority fetched; the text's "em crime doloso" reads more naturally as the kind of reincidência.

readings.description: An earlier doloso conviction, whatever the new crime.
readings.rejection_rationale: A culposo new crime is substitutable "qualquer que seja a pena" (I); barring it for an earlier doloso would contradict I.

taken.rationale: "reincidente em crime doloso" names the reincidência by its kind; both crimes doloso.

witnesses: cp-g1b-restritivas-de-direitos-testes.l4: an earlier culposo conviction does not bar; a culposo new crime after an earlier doloso does not bar

site.anchor: o § 3º do art. 44 permite a substituição ao reincidente

source.quote: a reincidência não se tenha operado em virtude da prática do mesmo crime

readings.description: "o mesmo crime" is the same offence, by its article.
Crimes of the same kind (same protected interest, similar elements).
readings.foreclosure: The text says "o mesmo crime", not "crime da mesma espécie", the phrase art. 71 uses when it means the wider class.

taken.rationale: Art. 71 uses "da mesma espécie" for the wider class; § 3º's "o mesmo crime" is narrower. Compared by the conviction's `tipo penal` and the crime's.

witnesses: cp-g1b-restritivas-de-direitos-testes.l4: an earlier estelionato admits § 3º; an earlier furto against a furto does not

entries.delegated_field: o salário mínimo (parameter)

site.anchor: a prestação pecuniária está nos limites (art. 45, § 1º)

source.quote: não inferior a 1 (um) salário mínimo nem superior a 360 (trezentos e sessenta) salários mínimos

citations.cite: CP art. 49, § 1º — "vigente ao tempo do fato"

readings.description: The minimum wage is an input; the paragraph does not say at which date it is taken.
As art. 49, § 1º says for the dia-multa, the wage in force at the time of the fact.
readings.foreclosure: Art. 45 does not borrow art. 49's words.

readings.description: The wage in force when the judge fixes the payment.
readings.foreclosure: Not stated either.

taken.rationale: The text is silent; the caller supplies the wage, and the question is left to a lawyer.

site.anchor: as horas de tarefa (art. 46, § 3º)

source.quote: devendo ser cumpridas à razão de uma hora de tarefa por dia de condenação

readings.description: The days of the condemnation are the calendar days of the term counted from its start (art. 10): a year from 1.1.2026 is 365 hours, from 1.1.2024 366.

citations.cite: CP art. 10 — "Contam-se os dias, os meses e os anos pelo calendário comum."

readings.description: Thirty-day months: a year is 360 hours.
readings.rejection_rationale: Art. 10 counts days by the common calendar; the 30-day convention is the dosimetry's (F-g0-03), not a term's.

readings.description: 365 days a year regardless of leap years.
readings.foreclosure: A simplification the text does not make.

taken.rationale: A term served is counted on the calendar (F-g0-03); the hours follow the days.

witnesses: cp-g1b-restritivas-de-direitos-testes.l4: 365 and 366 hours for a year from 2026 and from 2024; 181 for six months from 1.1.2026

entries.delegated_field: Crime em julgamento.agravantes que constituem ou qualificam o crime

site.anchor: as circunstâncias agravantes (arts. 61 e 62)

source.quote: Art. 61 - São circunstâncias que sempre agravam a pena, quando não constituem ou qualificam o crime:

readings.description: Which circumstances constitute or qualify the crime is the offence's own (its elements and qualificadoras); the crime record lists them and they are excluded, from art. 62 too.
The Parte Geral decides it by comparing each circumstance with the offence's definition.
readings.rejection_rationale: That needs the whole Parte Especial, which g1b may not import.

taken.rationale: The offence encoder or the court knows the elements; the list travels with the crime.

witnesses: cp-g1b-circunstancias-testes.l4: a base motive listed as the crime's qualificadora does not aggravate again
notes: Extending the exclusion to art. 62 is g1b's reading (same bis in idem); art. 62 does not say it.
F-sweep-c-08 (art. 61, II, f against art. 226, II; STJ Tema 1215, M-sweep-c-13) is the art. 226 encoder's; it bears on this list.

site.anchor: contra ascendente, descendente, irmão ou cônjuge (art. 61, II, e)

source.quote: e) contra ascendente, descendente, irmão ou cônjuge;

readings.description: "cônjuge" is the spouse by marriage; a companheiro is not included.
A companheiro in a união estável is included.
readings.foreclosure: An agravante read to reach a relation the text does not name is analogy against the accused.

taken.rationale: Penal law does not extend an aggravating circumstance by analogy; where the Code wants the companheiro it names him (e.g., art. 226, II).

witnesses: cp-g1b-circunstancias-testes.l4: `contra a companheira` gives no agravante

site.anchor: com abuso de autoridade, relações domésticas ou violência contra a mulher (art. 61, II, f)

source.quote: f) com abuso de autoridade ou prevalecendo-se de relações domésticas, de coabitação ou de hospitalidade, ou com violência contra a mulher na forma da lei específica;

readings.description: The relation must exist and the agent must have taken advantage of it (a finding).
The relation alone makes out the limb.
readings.rejection_rationale: "prevalecendo-se" is a participle of action: taking advantage, not merely standing in the relation.

taken.rationale: The verb is the element.

witnesses: cp-g1b-circunstancias-testes.l4: a guest who did not take advantage — no agravante

site.anchor: a exceção da violência sexual contra a mulher (art. 65, I)

source.quote: I - ser o agente menor de 21 (vinte e um) anos, na data do fato, ou maior de 70 (setenta) anos, na data da sentença, salvo se o crime envolver violência sexual contra a mulher;

readings.description: The exception reaches both the under-21 and the over-70 limbs.

citations.cite: Lei nº 15.160/2025, ementa: "vedar a redução do prazo de prescrição para os crimes que envolvam violência sexual contra a mulher, quando o agente for, na data do fato, menor de 21 (vinte e um) anos ou, na data da sentença, maior de 70 (setenta) anos de idade"

readings.description: The exception follows only the over-70 limb it sits beside.
readings.rejection_rationale: The amending law's own ementa names both ages.

taken.rationale: The amending law says so in its ementa. Only facts from 4.7.2025 (Lei 15.160, in force on publication) are reached.

witnesses: cp-g1b-circunstancias-testes.l4: Eduardo (under 21) and Otávio (70) both lose the atenuante for a crime of 4.7.2025 involving sexual violence against a woman, and keep it for 3.7.2025

site.anchor: o novo crime é posterior ao trânsito em julgado da condenação (art. 63)

source.quote: Art. 63 - Verifica-se a reincidência quando o agente comete novo crime, depois de transitar em julgado a sentença que, no País ou no estrangeiro, o tenha condenado por crime anterior.

readings.description: The new crime on a later day than the day the conviction became final.
A crime on the day of the trânsito, after it, is reincidência.
readings.foreclosure: The record gives dates, not hours; on the day of the trânsito, "depois" cannot be shown.

taken.rationale: Dates carry no hour; in doubt the reading favourable to the accused.

witnesses: cp-g1b-circunstancias-testes.l4: a crime on 10.1.2020, the day of the trânsito, is not reincidência; on 11.1.2020 it is

site.anchor: a condenação anterior não prevalece pelo decurso de cinco anos (art. 64, I)

source.quote: I - não prevalece a condenação anterior, se entre a data do cumprimento ou extinção da pena e a infração posterior tiver decorrido período de tempo superior a 5 (cinco) anos, computado o período de prova da suspensão ou do livramento condicional, se não ocorrer revogação;

readings.description: The five years run from the start of an unrevoked probation period, else from the cumprimento or extinção; counted by art. 10, a crime on or after the fifth anniversary is after more than five years.
More than five years only from the day after the anniversary.
readings.foreclosure: Art. 10 includes the first day; by the anniversary five full years have run.

readings.description: The five years run from the cumprimento or extinção even where there was probation.
readings.rejection_rationale: "computado o período de prova" counts the probation period inside the five years.

taken.rationale: The Code's own counting rule, and the reading favourable to the accused.

witnesses: cp-g1b-circunstancias-testes.l4: served 10.3.2015 — reincidente on 9.3.2020, not on 10.3.2020; probation from 1.1.2014 purges by 1.1.2019

site.anchor: a agravante é preponderante (art. 67)

source.quote: Art. 67 - No concurso de agravantes e atenuantes, a pena deve aproximar-se do limite indicado pelas circunstâncias preponderantes, entendendo-se como tais as que resultam dos motivos determinantes do crime, da personalidade do agente e da reincidência.

readings.description: Preponderant: the reincidência; the motives of art. 61, II, a and b, art. 62, IV and art. 65, III, a; of the personality, the age (art. 65, I) and the confession (art. 65, III, d). A multirreincidente's reincidência preponderates over a confession; one reincidência and a confession may be fully compensated.

citations.cite: STJ, Tema repetitivo 585 (thesis as reformulated by the Terceira Seção in REsp 1.931.145/SP, 22.6.2022), as quoted by the TJDFT

readings.description: Only circumstances that are literally motives or the reincidência; age and confession are not.
readings.foreclosure: Tema 585 compensates confession and reincidência as equals, which presupposes the confession preponderates.

taken.rationale: The article names three sources, not a list; the mapping is g1b's reading, with Tema 585 for the confession.

witnesses: cp-g1b-circunstancias-testes.l4: a motive against a plain atenuante — agravantes preponderate; a multirreincidente against a confession — agravantes preponderate
notes: STJ Tema 585 thesis, as quoted: "É possível, na segunda fase da dosimetria da pena, a compensação integral da atenuante da confissão espontânea com a agravante da reincidência, seja ela específica ou não. Todavia, nos casos de multirreincidência, deve ser reconhecida a preponderância da agravante prevista no art. 61, I, do Código Penal, sendo admissível a sua compensação proporcional com a atenuante da confissão espontânea". Found by g1b (WebSearch/WebFetch, 2026-09-29); sweep-a lists Tema 585 as not fetched (S-sweep-a-07).
Where both sides have a preponderant circumstance otherwise, or neither does, the Code gives no direction and the range is the whole cominated range.

site.anchor: o último dia para pagar a multa (art. 50)

source.quote: A multa deve ser paga dentro de 10 (dez) dias depois de transitada em julgado a sentença.

readings.description: Ten days beginning the day after the trânsito: the last is the tenth day after it.
Counted by art. 10 from the day of the trânsito itself: the last is the ninth day after it.
readings.rejection_rationale: "depois de transitada" starts the ten days after the trânsito.

taken.rationale: "depois de" puts the first day after the trânsito; the same day results from the procedural rule of excluding the first day.

witnesses: cp-g1b-multa-testes.l4: final on 1.9.2026, last day 11.9.2026

site.anchor: a condição do art. 54, como impressa

source.quote: Art. 54 - As penas restritivas de direitos são aplicáveis, independentemente de cominação na parte especial, em substituição à pena privativa de liberdade, fixada em quantidade inferior a 1 (um) ano, ou nos crimes culposos.

citations.cite: CP art. 44, I (redação da Lei nº 9.714/1998)

readings.description: Art. 44 (1998) governs the quantity; art. 54 (1984) keeps its "independentemente de cominação".
Substitution only below one year for dolosos, as art. 54 prints.
readings.rejection_rationale: The later law re-wrote art. 44 to reach four years; reading art. 54 as still limiting would empty that change.

taken.rationale: Lex posterior on the same subject; art. 54 was not re-worded in 1998.

witnesses: cp-g1b-cominacao-testes.l4: two years, doloso — art. 54 as printed says no, art. 44 says yes

site.anchor: as interdições aplicáveis ao crime (arts. 47, 56 e 57)

source.quote: Art. 56 - As penas de interdição, previstas nos incisos I e II do art. 47 deste Código, aplicam-se para todo o crime cometido no exercício de profissão, atividade, ofício, cargo ou função, sempre que houver violação dos deveres que lhes são inerentes.

readings.description: Interdictions I and II apply only under art. 56, III only under art. 57; IV and V (added later) have no such condition.
Arts. 56 and 57 say where the interdictions apply without excluding other cases.
readings.foreclosure: An interdiction unrelated to the crime would be a penalty without a link to the fact; the articles name the link.

taken.rationale: The articles state the link between the crime and each interdiction.

witnesses: cp-g1b-cominacao-testes.l4: a crime of no special kind gets only IV and V

site.anchor: a multa substitutiva cabe independentemente de cominação (art. 58, parágrafo único)

source.quote: Parágrafo único - A multa prevista no parágrafo único do art. 44 e no § 2º do art. 60 deste Código aplica-se independentemente de cominação na parte especial.

citations.cite: CP art. 44 (redação da Lei nº 9.714/1998), which has §§ 1º to 5º and no parágrafo único

readings.description: The dangling reference is to the substitutive fine of art. 44, § 2º.
The reference is spent and only art. 60, § 2º's fine applies independently of cominação.
readings.foreclosure: The 1984 parágrafo único of art. 44 was the substitutive fine; § 2º is where Lei nº 9.714/1998 put it.

taken.rationale: Lei nº 9.714/1998 moved the substitutive fine into § 2º and did not update the cross-reference.

notes: A drafting defect in the compiled text: a cross-reference to a paragraph that no longer exists.

entries.delegated_field: Crime em julgamento.classificações (crime contra a dignidade sexual)

site.anchor: a valoração do comportamento da vítima é admissível (ADPF 1.107)

source.quote: bem como ao comportamento da vítima

readings.description: "crimes sexuais" are the crimes against sexual dignity (Título VI), a classification on the crime record; the arm governs sentences from 6.5.2024, and before it the rule refuses.
The interpretação conforme declares the only constitutional reading, so it reaches earlier sentences too.
readings.foreclosure: Whether and how the ruling reaches sentences before it is not in the quoted decision; the encoding declines rather than answer.

taken.rationale: The ruling does not list the crimes; Título VI is the evident core (as M-sweep-a-04 suggests). The date follows the sweep's arm.

witnesses: cp-g1b-aplicacao-da-pena-testes.l4: a sentence of 5.5.2024 refuses; of 6.5.2024, inadmissible

site.anchor: o valor do dia-multa está nos limites (arts. 49 e 60, § 1º)

source.quote: § 1º - A multa pode ser aumentada até o triplo, se o juiz considerar que, em virtude da situação econômica do réu, é ineficaz, embora aplicada no máximo.

readings.description: The value of the dia-multa may be tripled, to fifteen minimum wages.

citations.cite: CP art. 60, caput — "à situação econômica do réu"

readings.description: The whole fine, days and value, may be tripled once both are at their maximum.
readings.foreclosure: The economic situation governs the value of the day, not the number of days (art. 49); the two readings meet at the maximum.

taken.rationale: The criterion is economic, which art. 49 ties to the value of the day.

witnesses: cp-g1b-aplicacao-da-pena-testes.l4: 22,500 reais a day admitted on the finding of ineffectiveness, with a minimum wage of 1,500

site.anchor: cabe a multa substitutiva (art. 60, § 2º)

source.quote: § 2º - A pena privativa de liberdade aplicada, não superior a 6 (seis) meses, pode ser substituída pela de multa, observados os critérios dos incisos II e III do art. 44 deste Código.

readings.description: Both stand as printed: art. 60, § 2º for up to six months under art. 44's II and III, art. 44, § 2º under all of art. 44.
Art. 44, § 2º (1998) tacitly revoked art. 60, § 2º, so violence bars the fine too.
readings.foreclosure: Nothing in the source revokes art. 60, § 2º; Lei 9.714 left it in place. No authority fetched.

taken.rationale: The text keeps both; a revocation not stated is a question for a lawyer.

witnesses: cp-g1b-aplicacao-da-pena-testes.l4: four months with violence — the fine of art. 60, § 2º only

site.anchor: as opções da terceira fase (art. 68, parágrafo único)

source.quote: Parágrafo único - No concurso de causas de aumento ou de diminuição previstas na parte especial, pode o juiz limitar-se a um só aumento ou a uma só diminuição, prevalecendo, todavia, a causa que mais aumente ou diminua.

readings.description: The cause that most increases or decreases is the one with the larger largest fraction, then the larger smallest; the judge may limit increases, decreases, or both.
"ou" allows limiting only increases or only decreases, not both.
readings.foreclosure: Nothing in the text excludes doing both; each limb is its own power.

taken.rationale: A range's reach is its largest fraction.

witnesses: cp-g1b-aplicacao-da-pena-testes.l4: of a third and a half, the half is kept; of "até o dobro" and a third, the first

site.anchor: a mais grave das penas (art. 70)

source.quote: aplica-se-lhe a mais grave das penas cabíveis ou, se iguais, somente uma delas

readings.description: The penalty fixed for each crime; the reclusão is graver than the detenção, then the longer.
The longer penalty, whatever its species.
readings.foreclosure: No authority fetched; the Code ranks reclusão above detenção in arts. 33 and 69.

taken.rationale: The Code ranks the species; within one, the longer is graver.

witnesses: cp-g1b-concurso-de-crimes-testes.l4: two years of reclusão over three of detenção give 28 to 36 months (the other reading, 42 to 54)

site.anchor: aumento do art. 71, parágrafo único

source.quote: observadas as regras do parágrafo único do art. 70 e do art. 75 deste Código

citations.cite: CP art. 75, caput — "O tempo de cumprimento"

readings.description: Art. 75 limits the time served, so the penalty imposed is capped only by art. 70's parágrafo único.
The penalty imposed under the parágrafo único may not exceed forty years.
readings.foreclosure: Art. 75 speaks of "tempo de cumprimento"; Súmula 715 STF treats its ceiling as a limit on time served.

taken.rationale: Art. 75's own words; consistent with F-sweep-a-08.

site.anchor: o intervalo da pena no concurso (arts. 69 a 71)

source.quote: Parágrafo único - Não poderá a pena exceder a que seria cabível pela regra do art. 69 deste Código.

citations.cite: CP art. 71, parágrafo único — "observadas as regras do parágrafo único do art. 70"

site.anchor: a pena privativa de liberdade está extinta pelo art. 82

source.quote: Art. 82 - Expirado o prazo sem que tenha havido revogação, considera-se extinta a pena privativa de liberdade.

readings.description: An obligatory cause of revocation that arose during the period bars the extinction even if the judge had not decreed the revocation before the period ended; the judge must still revoke.

citations.cite: CP art. 81, caput — 'A suspensão será revogada se, no curso do prazo, ...'

readings.description: Only a revocation decreed before the period expires bars the extinction; once the period has run with no revocation decreed, the penalty is extinct, whatever happened during it.

citations.cite: CP art. 82 — 'sem que tenha havido revogação'

readings.foreclosure: Art. 81's caput makes revocation mandatory and ties it to what happened 'no curso do prazo', not to the date of the decree; reading art. 82 alone would let the court's delay defeat a mandatory rule. Case law on revocation after the period was not retrieved for this encoding.

taken.rationale: Art. 81 says the suspension 'será revogada' for causes arising in the period; art. 82's 'sem que tenha havido revogação' is read with that command, not against it. A facultative cause the judge did not use does not bar the extinction.
