source.quote: Art. 94 - A reabilitação poderá ser requerida, decorridos 2 (dois) anos do dia em que for extinta, de qualquer modo, a pena ou terminar sua execução, computando-se o período de prova da suspensão e o do livramento condicional, se não sobrevier revogação, desde que o condenado:

readings.description: A probation period not revoked counts within the two years: they run from its first day, and the application is open from the later of the extinction and the day after two years from that first day.

citations.cite: CP art. 94 — 'computando-se o período de prova'

readings.description: The two years run from the extinction, and the probation period is added to the record of good conduct the court weighs, not to the count.
readings.rejection_rationale: 'Computando-se' in a sentence about a period of years is counting time; read the other way the phrase would have no work to do in the caput, which is about the period.

taken.rationale: 'Computar' a period within a period of years is to count its time; the caput's subject is when the application may be made.

witnesses: cp-g1c-efeitos-e-reabilitacao-testes.l4: a two-year sursis ending on 10 January 2026 — application open the same day

site.anchor: Parte Geral, arts. 77 a 120 — o que os capítulos de g1c compartilham

source.quote: Parágrafo único - A lei posterior, que de qualquer modo favorecer o agente, aplica-se aos fatos anteriores, ainda que decididos por sentença condenatória transitada em julgado.

readings.description: Where a later law made one of these provisions harsher, the date that decides which wording governs is the date of the crime: for an earlier crime the earlier wording governs — a paragraph added later does not apply, and a provision re-worded later refuses, since the text it replaced is not in the source.

citations.cite: CP art. 2º, parágrafo único — the more favourable later law reaches earlier facts; the harsher one does not
CP art. 4º — the time of the crime is the moment of the action or omission

readings.description: The provisions on execution, effects, decadência and prescription are procedural or executory, and the wording in force at the decision governs.
readings.foreclosure: Prescription, decadência, the effects of conviction and the conditions of the benefits all bear on how much of the penalty is suffered, and are treated as penal law, which does not reach back when harsher. A court classing one of them as procedural would apply the later wording.

taken.rationale: Every provision gated in this encoding bears on punishment: whether and how long it is served, and what follows from it. Art. 2º says a more favourable later law reaches back; a harsher one therefore does not.

witnesses: cp-g1c-livramento-condicional-testes.l4: `um caso de crime em 22.1.2020` (REFUSED) and `... 23.1.2020`
cp-g1c-efeitos-e-reabilitacao-testes.l4: art. 91-A for a crime on 22.1.2020 (not law) and on 23.1.2020; art. 92, II on 9 and 10 October 2024
notes: The gates are where the dates are: `a vigência ...` constants in each module. Which of those dates were confirmed, and where, is in notes/g1c.md.
A later law that made a provision MORE favourable reaches earlier facts under art. 2º, parágrafo único; no rule here is gated on such a change.

The conductor's rulings of 2026-09-30 (PLAN § 10, strict): a provision re-worded later refuses for EVERY earlier fact, even one its present words would not reach, because what the earlier wording said is in no bundled source. Applied to art. 115 (every crime before 4.7.2025), art. 92, II (every fact before 10.10.2024) and art. 92, § 2º (every fact from 10.10.2024 to 6.8.2026, a refusal that reaches art. 92, I and the list of effects in that window). The refused assertions were kept, flipped to #ASSERT REFUSED with the reason, each still carrying the answer the present words give.

Measured cost, art. 115 — strict gate: 36 of 119 prescription assertions refuse; no prescription is computable for a crime before 4.7.2025 until the vintage pass brings the pre-2025 art. 115 into the bundle. The count was taken on the suite as it stood at the ruling. Fifteen post-amendment twin assertions (crimes of 2025–2030) were then added, so that the count, art. 110, § 1º, the third for the repeat offender and art. 117, V's stop are still exercised: 12 of 12 prescription mutations caught. Every prescription passes through art. 115, which is why the cost is so wide, and that is the argument for bringing arts. 115 and 92 into the bundle first in the vintage pass.

Measured cost, art. 92, § 2º: in the tests as they stood, one assertion changed (a fact of 1.1.2025 that the present words do not reach); two more were added for the spread to art. 92, I and the list of effects. Art. 92, I still answers TRUE in that window where its own thresholds are met, because its 'ou' is decided before § 2º is consulted.

site.anchor: o fato é punível com detenção (art. 97)

source.quote: Se, todavia, o fato previsto como crime for punível com detenção, poderá o juiz submetê-lo a tratamento ambulatorial.

citations.cite: CP art. 235, § 1º; art. 306, parágrafo único — the preceitos that leave the species to the judge

readings.description: 'Punível com detenção' where the preceito prescribes detenção or leaves the species to the judge between reclusão and detenção; not where it prescribes reclusão alone, nor where it prescribes a fine only.
An act punishable only with a fine is a fortiori open to outpatient treatment: if the lighter custodial species allows it, a penalty with no custody at all must.
readings.foreclosure: The words name detenção; the only fine-only preceito in the Code (art. 146-A) is recent, and whether a medida de segurança fits it at all is a question the text does not raise. A court could adopt the a fortiori reading.

readings.description: Outpatient treatment is open whatever the species, the choice following the medical need rather than the penalty.
readings.foreclosure: The caput ties the exception to detenção in terms. STJ case law said to allow outpatient treatment for acts punishable with reclusão was not retrieved by the sweep and is not a source of this encoding; it is recorded as an open question in notes/g1c.md.

taken.rationale: The caput says 'punível com detenção'. A preceito that lets the judge impose detenção makes the act punishable with it; one of reclusão alone, or of a fine alone, does not.

witnesses: cp-g1c-medidas-de-seguranca-testes.l4: `espécie ao juiz, até 3` (both measures) and `só multa` (committal only)

site.anchor: as medidas que podem substituir a pena (art. 98)

source.quote: a pena privativa de liberdade pode ser substituída pela internação, ou tratamento ambulatorial, pelo prazo mínimo de 1 (um) a 3 (três) anos, nos termos do artigo anterior e respectivos §§ 1º a 4º.

readings.description: For the partly responsible convict both measures are open, whatever the species of the penalty; 'nos termos do artigo anterior e respectivos §§ 1º a 4º' brings in the regime of the measure (term, examinations, release, conversion), not the caput's species rule.

citations.cite: CP art. 98 — 'pela internação, ou tratamento ambulatorial', unconditioned

readings.description: 'nos termos do artigo anterior' carries the caput too: outpatient treatment only where the act is punishable with detenção.
readings.foreclosure: Art. 98 names both measures itself and then refers to 'o artigo anterior e respectivos §§ 1º a 4º' — the paragraphs that regulate a measure already chosen. A court reading the reference to include the caput would take this reading.

taken.rationale: Art. 98 names both measures without condition, and the reference that follows lists the paragraphs that regulate a measure's duration and end.

witnesses: cp-g1c-medidas-de-seguranca-testes.l4: art. 98 returns both measures

site.anchor: o tempo máximo da medida de segurança (art. 97, § 1º; Súmula 527 STJ)

source.quote: § 1º - A internação, ou tratamento ambulatorial, será por tempo indeterminado, perdurando enquanto não for averiguada, mediante perícia médica, a cessação de periculosidade. O prazo mínimo deverá ser de 1 (um) a 3 (três) anos. (Redação dada pela Lei nº 7.209, de 11.7.1984)

readings.description: As printed: no maximum; the measure lasts until a medical examination finds the dangerousness has ceased.
readings.foreclosure: Foreclosed in STJ practice by Súmula 527; no court has struck it in abstract review as far as this sweep reached.

readings.description: Bounded by the maximum penalty abstractly cominated for the act committed.
Bounded by art. 75's general ceiling on time served (the line associated with the STF, not retrieved in this sweep; stated here without an authority quote).
readings.foreclosure: Not retrieved: portal.stf.jus.br was unreachable. Recorded so the encoder knows the STF line may differ from the STJ's.

taken.rationale: Settled by Súmula 527 STJ, taken as the sweep proposes. The maximum is read with the case's causes at their outer limits, as for art. 109 (F-g1c-15); a fine-only preceito has no custodial maximum, and the encoding refuses there.

settled_by.citation: Súmula 527 STJ: 'O tempo de duração da medida de segurança não deve ultrapassar o limite máximo da pena abstratamente cominada ao delito praticado.' (julgado em 13/05/2015, DJe 18/05/2015)

site.anchor: pode oferecer queixa ou prosseguir na ação em lugar do ofendido (art. 100, § 4º)

source.quote: § 4º - No caso de morte do ofendido ou de ter sido declarado ausente por decisão judicial, o direito de oferecer queixa ou de prosseguir na ação passa ao cônjuge, ascendente, descendente ou irmão.

readings.description: The right passes to the spouse, ascendant, descendant or sibling, as printed; a companheiro in a stable union is not listed.
The companheiro in a stable union takes the spouse's place, the Constitution recognising the stable union as a family entity.
readings.foreclosure: The Code lists 'cônjuge'. The constitutional argument (CF art. 226, § 3º) and any case law extending the list are outside this encoding's sources, and a list of who may prosecute is not widened by analogy without authority. A court may well take this reading.

taken.rationale: The encoding carries the list as printed; the extension to the companheiro needs an authority this encoding's sources do not include, and it is flagged in notes/g1c.md for a Brazilian lawyer.

witnesses: cp-g1c-acao-penal-testes.l4: `companheiro` — FALSE

site.anchor: a ação penal do crime complexo (art. 101)

source.quote: Art. 101 - Quando a lei considera como elemento ou circunstâncias do tipo legal fatos que, por si mesmos, constituem crimes, cabe ação pública em relação àquele, desde que, em relação a qualquer destes, se deva proceder por iniciativa do Ministério Público.

readings.description: Where any component crime is prosecuted on the Ministério Público's initiative, the complex crime's action is public, even over its own article's declaration of a private action; among the public actions in play, the least conditioned.

citations.cite: STF, Súmula 608 (cited by number only: its text could not be retrieved from an official source, see notes)

readings.description: Art. 101 applies only where the complex crime's own article states no action; where it declares a private action, that declaration governs as the more specific law.

citations.cite: CP art. 100, caput — 'salvo quando a lei expressamente a declara privativa do ofendido'

readings.rejection_rationale: Where the complex crime's article is silent, art. 100 already makes its action public, so on this reading art. 101 would have nothing to do.

taken.rationale: Only this reading gives art. 101 work to do. Which public action applies when the components' differ is the encoder's: the least conditioned, since art. 101 speaks of the Ministério Público proceeding on its own initiative.

witnesses: cp-g1c-acao-penal-testes.l4: a private-action complex crime with a public component — public
notes: Súmula 608 STF is cited by number only, on the conductor's ruling of 2026-09-30. An earlier version of this entry quoted its text from memory; that quotation was removed. Its text could not be retrieved from an official or LexML source on 2026-09-30: portal.stf.jus.br/jurisprudencia/sumariosumulas.asp?base=30&sumula=2694 and the STF's PDF of súmulas 1–736 returned HTTP 403 to this machine, and a fetch through another route failed STF's certificate check; LexML's URN resolver had no document for urn:lex:br:supremo.tribunal.federal;plenario:sumula:1984-10-17;608, and its search is behind a JavaScript check. sweep-a's S-sweep-a-08 also lists it as not retrieved.

That the súmula applies this reading of art. 101 is the encoder's recollection, not a checked fact. A Brazilian criminal lawyer should confirm its text, whether it rests on art. 101, and what it still reaches after art. 225's rewrite (sweep-c's range).

site.anchor: a representação ainda era retratável (art. 102)

source.quote: Art. 102 - A representação será irretratável depois de oferecida a denúncia.

citations.cite: CP art. 106, § 2º — 'Não é admissível o perdão depois que passa em julgado a sentença condenatória'

readings.description: Where the two acts fall on the same day, the dates do not say which came first; the encoding refuses by name rather than guess.

citations.cite: CP arts. 102 e 106, § 2º — 'depois de', an order the dates cannot show within a day

readings.description: An act on the same day as the barring event is in time, the bar running from the day after.
readings.foreclosure: 'depois de oferecida a denúncia' orders two acts, and a denúncia offered in the morning makes an afternoon retraction too late; the date alone cannot tell. The record of the hour would settle it.

readings.description: An act on the same day as the barring event is too late.
readings.foreclosure: The same objection the other way.

taken.rationale: Both provisions turn on the order of two acts, which a date does not carry within a day; the refusal names the missing fact.

witnesses: cp-g1c-acao-penal-testes.l4: retraction and denúncia on 10 March 2026 — REFUSED; pardon and trânsito on 10 March 2026 — REFUSED

site.anchor: os efeitos secundários da condenação subsistem (art. 107)

source.quote: II - pela anistia, graça ou indulto;

readings.description: Only the primary effect (the executória claim); secondary effects survive — the conviction still counts for reincidência, and the effects of arts. 91–92 stand.
Extinção da punibilidade by indulto extinguishes the conviction's effects generally, as anistia does.
readings.rejection_rationale: Struck by Súmula 631 STJ (M-sweep-a-30).

taken.rationale: Settled by Súmula 631 STJ. The encoding applies it to the indulto only, as the súmula is worded; for the graça, and for every cause the súmulas do not address, it refuses rather than extend them.

settled_by.citation: Súmula 631 STJ: 'O indulto extingue os efeitos primários da condenação (pretensão executória), mas não atinge os efeitos secundários, penais ou extrapenais.' (julgado em 24/04/2019, DJe 29/04/2019)

witnesses: cp-g1c-extincao-da-punibilidade-testes.l4: `indulto (art. 107, II)` — TRUE; `graça (art. 107, II)` — REFUSED

site.anchor: subsiste efeito condenatório da sentença (Súmula 18 STJ)

source.quote: Art. 120 - A sentença que conceder perdão judicial não será considerada para efeitos de reincidência. (Redação dada pela Lei nº 7.209, de 11.7.1984)

readings.description: Declaratory of extinção da punibilidade; no condemnatory effect survives.
Condemnatory: art. 120 excludes only reincidência, so other effects (e.g. the duty to indemnify under art. 91, I) survive.
readings.rejection_rationale: Struck by Súmula 18 STJ (M-sweep-a-31).

taken.rationale: Settled by Súmula 18 STJ; art. 120's narrower words are the reincidência half of it.

settled_by.citation: Súmula 18 STJ: 'A sentença concessiva do perdão judicial é declaratória da extinção da punibilidade, não subsistindo qualquer efeito condenatório.' (julgado em 20/11/1990, DJ 28/11/1990)

site.anchor: o prazo da multa antes do trânsito em julgado (art. 114)

source.quote: I - em 2 (dois) anos, quando a multa for a única cominada ou aplicada; (Incluído pela Lei nº 9.268, de 1º.4.1996)

readings.description: Before the conviction is final the fine is read as cominated; after, as applied. A fine cominated in the alternative ('ou multa') and applied alone therefore prescribes with the custodial penalty's period before the final judgment (II), and in two years after it (I).

citations.cite: CP art. 114 — 'cominada ou aplicada' against 'cominada ou cumulativamente aplicada'
CP arts. 109 e 110 — the same split between the penalty cominated and the penalty applied

readings.description: Once the fine alone has been applied, two years govern at every stage.
readings.foreclosure: Before the final judgment arts. 109–110 read the cominated penalty; applying inciso I's 'aplicada' there would measure the prosecution's prescription by a sentence that may still change. A court could still apply I as soon as a sentence imposes the fine alone.

taken.rationale: Read literally, a fine cominated in the alternative and applied alone falls under both incisos; the Code's own split between arts. 109 and 110 says which to read at which stage.

witnesses: cp-g1c-prescricao-testes.l4: `detenção de um a seis meses, ou multa` — three years before the final judgment; `o prazo da multa aplicada (art. 114)` NOTHING — two years after

site.anchor: os prazos de prescrição são reduzidos de metade (art. 115)

source.quote: Art. 115. São reduzidos de metade os prazos de prescrição quando o criminoso era, ao tempo do crime, menor de 21 (vinte e um) anos ou, na data da sentença, maior de 70 (setenta) anos, salvo se o crime envolver violência sexual contra a mulher. (Redação dada pela Lei nº 15.160, de 2025)

readings.description: 'na data da sentença' is the date of the first condemnatory decision: the sentence, or the acórdão where the conviction first comes on appeal; a later acórdão that confirms it does not move the date.
The date of the last condemnatory decision, a confirmatory acórdão included, so a convict who turns seventy while an appeal is pending gains the halving.
readings.foreclosure: The article says 'sentença', the decision that convicts; a confirming acórdão replaces it but does not convict anew. Case law on the point was not retrieved for this encoding.

taken.rationale: The input is named `data da sentença condenatória` and documented as the first conviction; which decision that is, where a court convicts on appeal, is for whoever supplies it.

witnesses: cp-g1c-prescricao-testes.l4: `Vicente, nascido em 10.6.1956`, crime of 1.8.2025 — sentence on 10.6.2026 (halved) and on 9.6.2026 (not)
notes: The rule refuses by name for every crime before 4.7.2025, the vigência of Lei nº 15.160/2025, whether or not the age engages the halving (the conductor's rulings of 2026-09-30; fork F-g1c-19). Measured: strict gate: 36 of 119 prescription assertions refuse; no prescription is computable for a crime before 4.7.2025 until the vintage pass brings the pre-2025 art. 115 into the bundle.
Sweep-a's copy of the 1984 wording (notes/g1c.md § 8) has the same age rule without the exception; a vintage pass that brings it into the bundle would restore every earlier crime's prescription.

site.anchor: o termo inicial da prescrição (art. 111)

source.quote: V - nos crimes contra a dignidade sexual ou que envolvam violência contra a criança e o adolescente, previstos neste Código ou em legislação especial, da data em que a vítima completar 18 (dezoito) anos, salvo se a esse tempo já houver sido proposta a ação penal.

citations.cite: CP art. 111, V (redação da Lei nº 14.344/2022)

readings.description: 'contra a criança e o adolescente' qualifies both kinds of crime: V reaches a crime against sexual dignity, or involving violence, whose victim was under eighteen at the time of the act.

citations.cite: CP art. 111, V — the period runs from the victim's eighteenth birthday, which only means something for a victim who was younger

readings.description: Every crime against sexual dignity, whatever the victim's age, runs from the victim's eighteenth birthday.
readings.rejection_rationale: For an adult victim the eighteenth birthday falls before the crime, so the period would run from before the act it prescribes; the inciso would then do nothing for adults and make no sense in its own terms.

taken.rationale: The inciso's term — the victim's eighteenth birthday — presupposes a victim under eighteen. The wording before 2022 (Lei nº 12.650/2012, as sweep-a reports it) said 'crimes contra a dignidade sexual de crianças e adolescentes', which points the same way; that text is outside the bundle and is noted, not relied on. 'a esse tempo já houver sido proposta' is read to include an action brought on the eighteenth birthday itself.

site.anchor: a prescrição da pretensão punitiva (arts. 109 a 117)

source.quote: § 1o A prescrição, depois da sentença condenatória com trânsito em julgado para a acusação ou depois de improvido seu recurso, regula-se pela pena aplicada, não podendo, em nenhuma hipótese, ter por termo inicial data anterior à da denúncia ou queixa. (Redação dada pela Lei nº 12.234, de 2010).

citations.cite: CP art. 117, I — 'pelo recebimento da denúncia ou da queixa'

readings.description: 'data anterior à da denúncia ou queixa' is the date the denúncia or queixa was offered: the count by the penalty applied starts no earlier than that day.

citations.cite: CP art. 110, § 1º — 'a da denúncia ou queixa', the act itself

readings.description: It is the date the court received the denúncia or queixa, the act that interrupts prescription (art. 117, I).
readings.foreclosure: The paragraph names the denúncia, not its receipt, where art. 117, I names the receipt. The difference is the days between offering and receipt, which the interruption at receipt makes small; a court reading 'denúncia' as its receipt would take this reading.

taken.rationale: The paragraph speaks of the denúncia or queixa itself; art. 117 shows the Code naming the receipt when it means the receipt.

witnesses: cp-g1c-prescricao-testes.l4: `P5` — a crime of 2015 charged in 2019 is not prescribed by the penalty applied
notes: The 1984 § 2º, revoked by Lei nº 12.234/2010, spoke of 'data anterior à do recebimento da denúncia ou da queixa' (sweep-a's copy of Lei nº 7.209/1984, outside the bundle). The 2010 text drops 'recebimento'.

site.anchor: o último dia do prazo, descontadas as suspensões

source.quote: Art. 116 - Antes de passar em julgado a sentença final, a prescrição não corre: (Redação dada pela Lei nº 7.209, de 11.7.1984)

readings.description: The days on which prescription did not run are added, as days, to the last day of the period counted by the calendar.

citations.cite: CP art. 116 — 'a prescrição não corre' on those days

readings.description: The period still to run when the suspension began is counted again, by the calendar, from the day after it ends.

citations.cite: CP art. 10 — 'Contam-se os dias, os meses e os anos pelo calendário comum'

readings.foreclosure: The two differ by a day or two across month ends and leap years. The Code says only that prescription 'não corre'; adding the days that did not run is the smallest reading of that.

taken.rationale: What art. 116 takes out is days; putting the same number of days back keeps the count exact whatever months the suspension spans.

witnesses: cp-g1c-prescricao-testes.l4: ten days in January 2022 push 31.12.2028 to 10.1.2029

site.anchor: a prescrição da pretensão executória

source.quote: VI - pela reincidência. (Redação dada pela Lei nº 9.268, de 1º.4.1996)

readings.description: The encoding takes the day of the interruption as supplied with the `reincidência (art. 117, VI)` event; which day that is, is decided by whoever supplies it, on one of the readings below.
The reincidência interrupts on the day the new crime is committed.
It interrupts on the day the conviction for the new crime becomes final, since only then is the convict a repeat offender (art. 63).

taken.rationale: 'pela reincidência' names no act and no day. The Code's definition of reincidência (art. 63) is g1b's, and case law on the day was not retrieved; the encoding records the question and takes the day as a fact.

source.quote: II - pela pronúncia;

readings.description: Yes: the pronúncia interrupts regardless of the later reclassification.
No: once the jury reclassifies, the pronúncia is treated as never having interrupted prescription.
readings.rejection_rationale: Struck by Súmula 191 STJ (M-sweep-a-32).

taken.rationale: Settled by Súmula 191 STJ. The encoding has no field for a later reclassification: a pronúncia event interrupts on its day.

site.anchor: aumento do art. 110, caput

source.quote: Art. 110 - A prescrição depois de transitar em julgado a sentença condenatória regula-se pela pena aplicada e verifica-se nos prazos fixados no artigo anterior, os quais se aumentam de um terço, se o condenado é reincidente. (Redação dada pela Lei nº 7.209, de 11.7.1984)

readings.description: No: the increase applies only to the executória prescription after final conviction; reincidência does not affect the punitive claim.
Yes, at least for § 1º, which also measures by the penalty applied and sits in the same article.
readings.rejection_rationale: Struck by Súmula 220 STJ (M-sweep-a-33).

taken.rationale: Settled by Súmula 220 STJ. The increase is applied in `o prazo da prescrição da pretensão executória (arts. 110 e 115)` only; the punitive-claim periods have no field for reincidência.

site.anchor: as datas de interrupção da pretensão punitiva (art. 117, I a IV)

source.quote: IV - pela publicação da sentença ou acórdão condenatórios recorríveis;

citations.cite: CP art. 117, IV (redação da Lei nº 11.596/2007)

readings.description: Yes: a condemnatory acórdão always interrupts, including a confirmatory one, whatever it does to the penalty.
Only an acórdão that convicts for the first time (reversing an acquittal) or materially changes the penalty interrupts; a mere confirmation does not.
readings.rejection_rationale: Struck by STF, HC 176.473/RR (M-sweep-a-34).

taken.rationale: Settled by the STF's Plenary thesis. Any `publicação do acórdão condenatório recorrível` event interrupts, with no field for whether it confirmed.

settled_by.citation: HC 176.473/RR (27/04/2020): 'Nos termos do inciso IV do artigo 117 do Código Penal, o Acórdão condenatório sempre interrompe a prescrição, inclusive quando confirmatório da sentença de 1º grau, seja mantendo, reduzindo ou aumentando a pena anteriormente imposta.'

witnesses: cp-g1c-prescricao-testes.l4: `P8` — an acórdão of 1.1.2024 restarts the count

site.anchor: incide a diminuição do art. 121, § 1º

source.quote: Se o agente comete o crime impelido por motivo de relevante valor social ou moral, ou sob o domínio de violenta emoção, logo em seguida a injusta provocação da vítima, o juiz pode reduzir a pena de um sexto a um terço.

readings.description: § 1º applies to a qualified homicide only where the qualifying circumstance is about the means or the victim (§ 2º III, IV, VII, VIII, IX, X), not where it is itself a motive or a purpose (§ 2º I, II, V, and § 2º-D's 'no contexto ... ou para a consecução').

citations.cite: CP art. 121, § 1º — 'Se o agente comete o crime', not only the simple homicide
CP art. 121, § 2º, I, II and V — each a motive or purpose, which a motive of relevant social or moral value cannot coexist with

readings.description: § 1º applies alongside every qualifying circumstance.
readings.rejection_rationale: A killing cannot be at once for a motive of relevant social or moral value and for a torpe or fútil motive, or to secure another crime: the motives exclude each other, so the reading gives § 1º to facts it cannot describe.

readings.description: § 1º reduces only the simple homicide, because it stands before § 2º.
readings.rejection_rationale: The paragraph says 'o crime', not 'o homicídio simples'; its place before § 2º says nothing about its reach, and no word of § 2º excludes it.

taken.rationale: It is the only reading that neither applies § 1º to facts it cannot describe nor confines it by position. It is the common understanding of the 'homicídio qualificado-privilegiado'; no authority was fetched, so it is recorded as the encoder's reading.

witnesses: cp-g2a-homicidio-testes.l4: `por relevante valor, com meio cruel` (reduced) and `por relevante valor e por motivo fútil` (not)

site.anchor: diminuição do art. 121, § 1º

source.quote: o juiz pode reduzir a pena de um sexto a um terço

citations.cite: CP art. 121, § 5º — 'o juiz poderá deixar de aplicar a pena'
CP art. 129, § 5º — 'pode ainda substituir a pena de detenção pela de multa'

readings.description: Once the findings are made (the motive, the violent emotion after an unjust provocation), the reduction of §§ 1º and 4º is a cause the judge must apply, choosing only the fraction within 1/6 to 1/3; the pardon (§ 5º, § 8º) and the substitution (§ 5º of art. 129) are powers, returned as options.

citations.cite: CP art. 68 — the causes of decrease are the third phase

readings.description: 'pode' leaves the judge free not to reduce even with the findings made, so §§ 1º and 4º are options like § 5º, not causes.

taken.rationale: The findings §§ 1º and 4º turn on are the jury's and the judge's to make, and the encoding takes them as inputs; once they are made, treating the reduction as still optional would let the same findings yield two penalties. Either way the encoding never picks the fraction. The pardon and the substitution stay options, because their words ('poderá deixar de aplicar', 'pode substituir') name an act, not a quantity.

witnesses: cp-g2a-homicidio-testes.l4: `por relevante valor moral` — the reduction is listed
cp-g2a-lesao-corporal-testes.l4: `grave, sob violenta emoção`
notes: The reading follows g0's F-g0-27 on art. 155 § 2º, which took the privilege as the defendant's right once its requirements are met.

site.anchor: incide o aumento do art. 121, § 4º, segunda parte

source.quote: Sendo doloso o homicídio, a pena é aumentada de 1/3 (um terço) se o crime é praticado contra pessoa menor de 14 (quatorze) ou maior de 60 (sessenta) anos.

citations.cite: CP art. 121, § 2º, IX — 'contra menor de 14 (quatorze) anos' (Lei nº 14.344/2022)

readings.description: Since § 2º IX made the victim's age under fourteen a qualifying circumstance, § 4º's increase for a victim under fourteen does not apply to the homicide it already qualifies; the increase stays for the victim over sixty.
Both apply: IX qualifies the homicide (12 to 30 years) and § 4º increases it by a third, because the later law did not amend § 4º.

citations.cite: CP art. 121, § 4º — unamended by Lei nº 14.344/2022

taken.rationale: The same fact — the victim's age — would be counted twice, once to qualify and once to increase. Counting one circumstance once is the general rule of sentencing (the qualifying circumstance and the cause of increase must rest on different facts). No authority on this pair was fetched.

witnesses: cp-g2a-homicidio-testes.l4: `Helena aos 13` — qualified, no § 4º increase

site.anchor: o crime de matar que os fatos constituem (arts. 121 a 121-B)

source.quote: Art. 121-B. Matar descendente, ascendente, dependente, enteado ou pessoa sob guarda ou responsabilidade direta da mulher, com o fim específico de causar-lhe sofrimento, punição ou controle, no contexto de violência doméstica e familiar.

citations.cite: CP art. 121-A, caput — 'Matar mulher por razões da condição do sexo feminino'

readings.description: A killing that makes out both art. 121-A and art. 121-B (a woman killed to punish another woman, in a setting of domestic violence that also gives her own killing the razões of art. 121-A § 1º) is governed by art. 121-B; either special article displaces art. 121.

citations.cite: CP art. 121-B — the vicarious purpose is the more specific element

readings.description: Art. 121-A governs where both are made out, because it is about the victim herself.

taken.rationale: Both carry 20 to 40 years; they differ in their causes of increase. Art. 121-B adds to art. 121-A's elements a purpose aimed at a third person, and a norm with more elements is the special one. Either special article displaces art. 121 (especialidade).

witnesses: cp-g2a-homicidio-testes.l4: `a filha morta para punir a mãe`

site.anchor: incide o aumento do art. 121, § 6º

source.quote: A pena é aumentada de 1/3 (um terço) até a metade se o crime for praticado por milícia privada, sob o pretexto de prestação de serviço de segurança, ou por grupo de extermínio.

readings.description: Where § 2º-D governs (a member of an ultraviolent criminal organisation, paramilitary group or private militia, in the context of the conduct of art. 2º of Lei nº 15.358/2026), § 6º's increase for the militia's or group's action does not also apply.
§ 6º applies on top of § 2º-D's 20 to 40 years, since § 6º asks for a pretext of security or an extermination group, which § 2º-D does not.

taken.rationale: § 2º-D was enacted in 2026 with a penalty nearly double § 2º's for the action of exactly these groups; adding § 6º would count the group's action twice. The exclusion is drawn wide (any § 6º hypothesis beside § 2º-D) and a court could draw it narrower, for an extermination group that § 2º-D does not name.

witnesses: cp-g2a-homicidio-testes.l4: `pela milícia a pretexto de segurança, no contexto do § 2º-D`

site.anchor: nos três meses posteriores ao parto (art. 121-A, § 2º, I)

source.quote: durante a gestação, nos 3 (três) meses posteriores ao parto

readings.description: From the day of the birth to the last day of three months counted, by the calendar and with the first day included (art. 10), from the day after it: a birth on 1 April makes 1 July the last day.

citations.cite: CP art. 10 — 'O dia do começo inclui-se no cômputo do prazo'

readings.description: Three months counted from the day of the birth itself, the first day included: a birth on 1 April makes 30 June the last day.

taken.rationale: 'posteriores ao parto' starts the three months after the birth, and art. 10 then counts that first day; a killing on the same-numbered day three months later is still 'nos 3 meses posteriores'. The day of the birth itself, after the delivery, is also after the birth and is included.

witnesses: cp-g2a-homicidio-testes.l4: `três meses exatos após o parto` (1 July, increased) and `três meses e um dia após o parto` (2 July, not)

site.anchor: as razões da condição do sexo feminino alcançam o agente (art. 121-A, § 3º)

source.quote: Comunicam-se ao coautor ou partícipe as circunstâncias pessoais elementares do crime previstas no § 1º deste artigo.

readings.description: The razões of § 1º reach every co-author and participant, whether or not they were that person's own.
They reach a co-author or participant only if that person knew of them, as the general rule on the communication of elementares under art. 30 is usually read.

citations.cite: CP art. 30 — 'salvo quando elementares do crime'

readings.foreclosure: § 3º states the communication without a knowledge condition, and the case record carries no fact about the co-agent's knowledge; a court could still read one in from art. 30's doctrine.

taken.rationale: The text states the rule without qualification.

notes: The case record carries no fact about the co-agent's knowledge, so no test can tell the readings apart; `o feminicídio pelo partícipe` in cp-g2a-homicidio-testes.l4 shows the communication itself.

site.anchor: qualificado pelo art. 121, § 2º, III

source.quote: III - com emprego de veneno, fogo, explosivo, asfixia, tortura ou outro meio insidioso ou cruel, ou de que possa resultar perigo comum;

readings.description: Any explosive qualifies. The shared means `emprego de explosivo ou de artefato análogo que cause perigo comum` counts, and so does a local circumstance `com emprego de explosivo` for an explosive that caused no common danger.

citations.cite: CP art. 121, § 2º, III — 'explosivo', with common danger as a separate limb

readings.description: Only the shared means counts, so an explosive without common danger does not qualify under 'explosivo'.
readings.rejection_rationale: It would make 'explosivo' redundant with the inciso's last limb, 'ou de que possa resultar perigo comum', and the shared noun's wording is art. 155 § 4º-A's, not art. 121's.

taken.rationale: The inciso names the explosive by itself.

witnesses: cp-g2a-homicidio-testes.l4: `com explosivo`
notes: A noun gap in cp-dominio.l4, not a disagreement: the conductor may prefer to hoist a plain `emprego de explosivo` into `Meio empregado`.

site.anchor: lesão corporal do art. 129, § 9º

source.quote: § 10. Nos casos previstos nos §§ 1o a 3o deste artigo, se as circunstâncias são as indicadas no § 9o deste artigo, aumenta-se a pena em 1/3 (um terço).

readings.description: §§ 9º and 13 are forms of the slight injury. A serious, very serious or fatal injury is §§ 1º to 3º's, increased by § 10 where § 9º's circumstances are present; § 13 has no such companion.

citations.cite: CP art. 129, § 10 — the graver results go to §§ 1º a 3º with § 9º's circumstances as an increase

readings.description: §§ 9º and 13 apply to an injury of any grade and compete with §§ 1º to 3º, the heaviest pena governing.

citations.cite: CP art. 129, § 9º — 'Se a lesão for praticada contra ...', no grade stated

taken.rationale: § 10 exists only if § 9º does not already reach the graver results; the other reading makes § 10 idle wherever § 9º's pena is heavier. § 13 is read the same way for coherence. The consequence, the text's own since Lei nº 14.994/2024 raised § 9º and § 13 to 2–5 years: a slight domestic injury has a higher minimum (2 years) than a serious one (§ 1º's 1 year plus a third, 16 months).

witnesses: cp-g2a-lesao-corporal-testes.l4: `grave contra o irmão` (§ 1º with § 10) and `grave contra a mulher, por menosprezo` (§ 1º)

site.anchor: incide o aumento do art. 129, § 7º

source.quote: § 7o Aumenta-se a pena de 1/3 (um terço) se ocorrer qualquer das hipóteses dos §§ 4o e 6o do art. 121 deste Código.

citations.cite: CP art. 121, § 4º — one sentence for the culpable homicide, one for the intentional

readings.description: § 4º's first sentence (technical rule, failure to help, flight) serves the culpable injury, its second (victim under 14 or over 60) the intentional injury; § 6º's hypotheses serve either.

citations.cite: CP art. 121, § 4º — 'No homicídio culposo ...'; 'Sendo doloso o homicídio ...'

readings.description: Any hypothesis of § 4º increases any injury, intentional or culpable.

taken.rationale: Each hypothesis of § 4º is stated for one kind of homicide, and borrowing it carries that condition; 'fleeing to avoid arrest' after an intentional injury is a different thing from the culpable author's failure to stay. The fraction is § 7º's own 1/3, not § 6º's 1/3 to 1/2.

witnesses: cp-g2a-lesao-corporal-testes.l4: `a culposa com fuga` (increased) and `a dolosa com fuga` (not)

site.anchor: a natureza da lesão (art. 129, §§ 1º e 2º)

source.quote: § 1º Se resulta: I - Incapacidade para as ocupações habituais, por mais de trinta dias; II - perigo de vida; III - debilidade permanente de membro, sentido ou função; IV - aceleração de parto:

readings.description: Art. 129's own rules read the incisos the medical report attests (`Consequência da lesão corporal`) and compute the grade; `a natureza da lesão` returns it as the shared `Resultado` for the articles that read that.

citations.cite: CP art. 129, §§ 1º e 2º — the grades are defined by their results

readings.description: Art. 129 reads the grade from the shared `Resultado`, as every other article does (F-g0-07).

citations.cite: cp-dominio.l4, `Resultado` — the grade as the report classifies it

taken.rationale: PLAN § 6 gives §§ 1º–2º to this group to encode from the findings; reading the grade from `Resultado` here would leave §§ 1º and 2º without an encoding. The two meet in the report, which answers both the incisos and the grade; a test asserts the mapping.

notes: Cross-reference: g0's F-g0-07 (the grade as the medical report gives it), which this entry implements for art. 129.

site.anchor: incide o aumento do art. 129, § 10

source.quote: Nos casos previstos nos §§ 1o a 3o deste artigo

readings.description: § 10 reaches §§ 1º, 2º and 3º, not § 3º-A.

citations.cite: CP art. 129, § 10 — written in 2004, before § 3º-A existed

readings.description: '§§ 1º a 3º' runs through every paragraph numbered 1 to 3, § 3º-A included.

citations.cite: CP art. 129, § 3º-A — numbered within the range

taken.rationale: § 3º-A was inserted with its own pena (20 to 40 years) by a law that did not touch § 10, and the same law's § 8º-A expressly keeps its increase off § 3º-A; the range read as the text had it when written.

witnesses: cp-g2a-lesao-corporal-testes.l4: `a morte do irmão` (§ 10) and `a morte do irmão, no contexto da lei` (not)

site.anchor: incide o aumento do art. 129, § 12, I

source.quote: II - 2/3 (dois terços) ao dobro se a lesão dolosa for praticada nas dependências de instituição de ensino e:

citations.cite: CP art. 129, § 12, I, c — 'nas dependências de instituição de ensino'

readings.description: Where II applies, the school is counted in II and I, c) is not applied again.

citations.cite: CP art. 129, § 12, II — the school plus a further condition

readings.description: I, c) and II both apply, in cascade.
readings.rejection_rationale: II is I, c) with one more condition and a higher fraction; applying both counts the school twice.

taken.rationale: II is the special case of I, c).

witnesses: cp-g2a-lesao-corporal-testes.l4: `na escola` (I) and `na escola, vítima com deficiência` (II only)

site.anchor: incide o aumento do art. 129, § 11

source.quote: § 11. Na hipótese do § 9o deste artigo, a pena será aumentada de um terço se o crime for cometido contra pessoa portadora de deficiência.

readings.description: 'Na hipótese do § 9º' is the domestic setting § 9º describes: the increase applies wherever those relationships are present, the slight injury under § 9º and the graver ones under §§ 1º–3º with § 10.

citations.cite: CP art. 129, § 10 — 'se as circunstâncias são as indicadas no § 9º'

readings.description: Only where § 9º's own pena governs, i.e. the slight domestic injury.

taken.rationale: The other reading would increase a slight injury to a disabled relative and leave a serious one unincreased, which the text gives no reason for.

witnesses: cp-g2a-lesao-corporal-testes.l4: `grave contra o irmão com deficiência` (§§ 10 and 11)

site.anchor: Circunstância do crime contra a pessoa

source.quote: integrantes do sistema prisional e da Força Nacional de Segurança Pública

citations.cite: CP art. 121, § 2º, VII, a — '... e da Força Nacional'
CP art. 129, § 12, I, a — 'ou integrantes do sistema prisional ou da Força Nacional'

readings.description: The two alíneas name one class of victims: a member of the prison system, or of the National Force, either suffices in both articles.
Art. 121's 'e' asks for a member of both bodies at once.
readings.rejection_rationale: No one is at once a member of the prison system and of the National Force in the ordinary case; the 'e' is enumerative, as art. 129's 'ou' says.

taken.rationale: One enum member serves both provisions.

site.anchor: a morte, se houve, é a do § 3º

source.quote: § 3° Se resulta morte e as circunstâncias evidenciam que o agente não quís o resultado, nem assumiu o risco de produzí-lo:

readings.description: An injury followed by a death the agent wanted, or whose risk the agent accepted, is not art. 129 at all but homicide (art. 121); a death from a culpable injury is art. 121 § 3º. `crime de lesão corporal (art. 129)` is FALSE for both.

citations.cite: CP art. 129, § 3º — the death is art. 129's only on its stated condition

readings.description: Art. 129 still answers with the grade the report gives, and the death is left to art. 121 alongside.
readings.rejection_rationale: It would answer 'lesão corporal' for a killing, and the same facts would be both art. 129's and art. 121's crime.

taken.rationale: § 3º states the condition under which a death stays within art. 129.

witnesses: cp-g2a-lesao-corporal-testes.l4: `a morte querida` and `a morte culposa`

site.anchor: incide o aumento do art. 121, § 2º-B, I

source.quote: § 2º-B. A pena do homicídio contra menor de 14 (quatorze) anos é aumentada de:

citations.cite: CP art. 121, § 2º-C — 'A pena do homicídio cometido nas dependências de instituição de ensino'

readings.description: The increases of §§ 2º-B and 2º-C go with the circumstance (inciso IX, inciso X) and apply to whichever pena governs the intentional homicide, § 2º-D's included.

citations.cite: CP art. 121, § 2º-B — 'A pena do homicídio contra menor de 14 anos'

readings.description: They apply only to § 2º's pena (12 to 30 years), the one the incisos IX and X qualify to.

taken.rationale: The paragraphs name the homicide by its victim or place, not by its pena, and § 2º-D (2026) came after them without restricting them.

site.anchor: a ação penal da lesão corporal (art. 129)

source.quote_absent_reason: The Code states no ação penal for art. 129; the question is what the external rules make of its silence.

readings.description: Slight (caput, and §§ 9º and 13, which are its forms) and culpable (§ 6º) injuries need representação under Lei 9.099 art. 88; where the injury results from domestic and family violence against a woman, Lei 11.340 art. 41 disapplies Lei 9.099 and the action is pública incondicionada (STJ Súmula 542). Every other form is pública incondicionada.
The Code states no condition, so art. 100's default (pública incondicionada) governs every form of art. 129.
readings.rejection_rationale: Lei 9.099 art. 88 conditions the action for slight and culpable injuries 'além das hipóteses do Código Penal'.

taken.rationale: The statutes and the súmula decide the core. The open edge the sweep flagged — § 9º against a man, and § 13 outside a domestic setting — is decided here by the grade of the INJURY: art. 88 says 'lesões corporais leves', a grade, and both are slight injuries, so both need representação unless the violence is domestic and family violence against a woman. The alternative, that art. 88 is about the band of penalty (Lei 9.099's 'menor potencial ofensivo'), would make both unconditional; no authority on it was fetched.

settled_by.citation: Súmula 542 (julgado em 26/08/2015, DJe 31/08/2015)

witnesses: cp-g2a-lesao-corporal-testes.l4: `a lesão leve` (condicionada), `contra a esposa, em violência doméstica` (incondicionada), `contra o irmão` and `contra a mulher, por menosprezo` (the open edge, condicionada)
notes: The súmula settles the domestic-violence-against-a-woman arm; the open edge is the encoder's reading and is listed among the open questions in notes/g2a.md.

entries.delegated_field: Circunstância do crime contra a pessoa: violência doméstica e familiar (cp-g2a-comum.l4)

site.anchor: Circunstância do crime contra a pessoa

source.quote: I – violência doméstica e familiar;

citations.cite: CP art. 129, § 13 — 'nos termos do § 1º do art. 121-A'

readings.description: Lei 11.340 art. 5º's definition: a gender-based act in the domestic unit, the family, or any intimate relationship, 'independentemente de coabitação' (STJ Súmula 600).
The Code's own list in art. 129 § 9º (ascendant, descendant, sibling, spouse or partner, domestic worker, cohabitant, relations of hospitality).
readings.foreclosure: 'violência doméstica e familiar' is Lei 11.340's term of art, and § 9º does not use it; § 9º reaches relationships (a brother, a guest) that are not the gender-based violence the phrase names.

taken.rationale: The phrase is Lei 11.340's; the fact supplier certifies that the crime involves violence of that kind, cohabitation not required. It is kept apart from `menosprezo ou discriminação à condição de mulher` and from art. 129 § 9º's relationships, as the proposed fork asked.

witnesses: cp-g2a-homicidio-testes.l4: `o feminicídio doméstico`
cp-g2a-lesao-corporal-testes.l4: `contra o irmão` (§ 9º, not § 13)
notes: STJ Súmula 600 settles only that Lei 11.340 art. 5º does not require cohabitation; that art. 121-A § 1º I imports art. 5º is the encoder's reading of a term of art, so the entry is 'resolved', not 'settled'.

site.anchor: o crime de matar que os fatos constituem (arts. 121 a 121-B e 123)

source.quote: Art. 123 - Matar, sob a influência do estado puerperal, o próprio filho, durante o parto ou logo após:

citations.cite: CP art. 121, § 2º, IX — 'contra menor de 14 (quatorze) anos'

readings.description: Where the facts make out art. 123 it governs the death, before arts. 121-B, 121-A and 121; a newborn is under fourteen, but § 2º IX does not turn the mother's puerperal killing into a qualified homicide.

citations.cite: CP art. 123 — the special, privileged form of killing one's own child

readings.description: Since 2022 the killing of a child under fourteen is qualified homicide (12 to 30 years), and that reaches the newborn too.
readings.rejection_rationale: It would leave art. 123 without a case: every newborn is under fourteen. The special norm prevails over the general one (especialidade).

taken.rationale: Especialidade; the other reading empties art. 123.

witnesses: cp-g2a-homicidio-testes.l4: `o infanticídio` (art. 123) and `sem o estado puerperal` (art. 121 § 2º)
notes: The participation of a third party in an infanticide (does the puerperal state, an elementar, communicate under art. 30?) is not modelled: the record describes the mother's conduct.

site.anchor: o crime pelo qual responde o agente (art. 122)

source.quote: responde o agente pelo crime de homicídio, nos termos do art. 121 deste Código.

citations.cite: CP art. 122, § 6º — 'responde o agente pelo crime descrito no § 2º do art. 129'

readings.description: The agent answers for the other crime under that crime's own rules in full: art. 121's qualifications and causes (§ 2º IX for a victim under fourteen) and art. 129's causes (§ 7º for a victim under fourteen) apply to the same facts.

The victim's age or vulnerability, which is what sends the agent to the other crime, is not used again to qualify or increase it: § 7º gives homicide under art. 121's caput unless another circumstance qualifies it.

citations.cite: CP art. 122, §§ 6º e 7º — the vulnerability is the condition of the displacement

taken.rationale: The text sends the agent to the other crime 'nos termos' of its article, and says nothing to exclude any of its rules. Recorded with the alternative because it counts the victim's age twice (once to displace, once to qualify), which the encoding avoided in F-g2a-03 for art. 121 alone; a court could take the second reading.

witnesses: cp-g2a-suicidio-testes.l4: `Júlia, morte` (art. 121 § 2º by inciso IX) and `Júlia, lesão gravíssima` (art. 129 § 7º)

site.anchor: incide o aumento do art. 122, § 3º

source.quote: II - se a vítima é menor ou tem diminuída, por qualquer causa, a capacidade de resistência.

readings.description: 'menor', undefined, is a person under eighteen, the age of penal majority (art. 27).

citations.cite: CP art. 27 — 'Os menores de 18 (dezoito) anos são penalmente inimputáveis'

readings.description: 'menor' is under fourteen, the age §§ 6º and 7º name.
readings.rejection_rationale: §§ 6º and 7º say 'menor de 14 (quatorze) anos' when they mean it; § 3º II says 'menor' alone, and under fourteen with the gravest results the victim is §§ 6º–7º's anyway.

taken.rationale: The Code's own majority age where it says 'menor' unqualified.

witnesses: cp-g2a-suicidio-testes.l4: `contra Pedro aos 17` and `contra Pedro aos 18`

site.anchor: a gestante sofre lesão corporal de natureza grave (art. 127)

source.quote: a gestante sofre lesão corporal de natureza grave

citations.cite: CP art. 129, §§ 1º e 2º — the Code's two grades; only § 1º's heading says 'de natureza grave'

readings.description: 'lesão corporal de natureza grave' in these articles includes the very serious grade of art. 129 § 2º: a result graver than the one named cannot escape the provision that names the lesser.

citations.cite: CP art. 122, § 1º — 'de natureza grave ou gravíssima', the only place the Code names both

readings.description: Only the grade of art. 129 § 1º.

site.anchor: calúnia consumada (art. 138; art. 14, I)

source.quote: Caluniar alguém, imputando-lhe falsamente fato definido como crime

citations.cite: CP art. 14, I — "consumado, quando nele se reúnem todos os elementos de sua definição legal"

readings.description: Calúnia and difamação attack reputation (honra objetiva) and are consummated when the imputation reaches someone other than the one offended; injúria attacks dignity (honra subjetiva) and is consummated when the offence reaches the one offended. Before that, an interrupted execution (an intercepted letter) is an attempt.

citations.cite: CP art. 139 — "ofensivo à sua reputação"; art. 140 — "ofendendo-lhe a dignidade ou o decoro"

readings.description: Each is consummated as soon as the words are uttered or written, whoever learns of them.

citations.cite: CP arts. 138 a 140 — the verbs name the act, not its reception

readings.foreclosure: Reputation is what others think, and dignity what the offended feels: an imputation no third person learns of does not touch the first, and an insult the offended never learns of does not touch the second. The reading would also leave no room for the attempt the Code allows in written forms.

taken.rationale: The two are told apart by the good each protects, which the chapter's own words name (reputation; dignity or decorum). The facts are the circumstances `a ofensa chegou ao conhecimento de terceiro` and `a ofensa chegou ao conhecimento do ofendido`.

readings.description: Each crime predicate reports whether the facts meet its own article's words; where two are met, both are reported, and the apparent conflict (speciality, consunção) is resolved by the judge.

site.anchor: violação de direitos de autor e dos que lhe são conexos (art. 184, caput)

source.quote: Violar direitos de autor e os que lhe são conexos:

citations.cite: CP art. 184, caput (redação da Lei nº 10.695/2003)
CP art. 184, § 4º — "em conformidade com o previsto na Lei nº 9.610, de 19 de fevereiro de 1998"

readings.description: Art. 184 is a norma penal em branco. Whether a direito de autor or a connected right exists, whether it was violated, and whether a use is an exception or limitation, are answered by the copyright law in force, Lei nº 9.610/1998 (and, for computer programs, Lei nº 9.609/1998). The encoding takes those answers as findings the fact supplier makes under that law, and encodes none of it.

citations.cite: Lei nº 9.610/1998, art. 1º: "Esta Lei regula os direitos autorais, entendendo-se sob esta denominação os direitos de autor e os que lhes são conexos" — the caput's own words
CP art. 184, § 4º names Lei nº 9.610/1998 as the source of the exceptions and limitations

readings.description: The rights are those of Lei nº 5.988/1973, the law the Code's own "Vide" marker V3 points to.
readings.rejection_rationale: Lei nº 9.610/1998, art. 115, revoked Lei nº 5.988/1973 except its art. 17 and §§ 1º–2º (on registration). The Vide marker survives in the compiled Code as a historical pointer; the 2003 wording of art. 184 uses Lei nº 9.610's vocabulary, and § 4º cites Lei nº 9.610 by name.

citations.cite: Lei nº 9.610/1998, art. 115: "Ficam revogados ... as Leis nºs ... 5.988, de 14 de dezembro de 1973, excetuando-se o art. 17 e seus §§ 1º e 2º"

readings.description: Encode the relevant parts of Lei nº 9.610/1998 (what is protected, who holds the right, the exceptions of arts. 46–48) so that the violation is computed rather than supplied.
readings.rejection_rationale: Lei nº 9.610 is outside the source bundle and the brief ("read these and nothing else"); the brief for g3b asks for it as a fact supplier, not an encoding.

taken.rationale: The Code does not define the rights; the copyright law does, in the caput's own words. Two booleans on the case record carry its answers: that there is a violation, and that the use is an exception or limitation. By Lei nº 9.610/1998, art. 46 ("Não constitui ofensa aos direitos autorais"), a use within an exception is no violation, so a consistent supplier who reports an exception reports no violation; the encoding does not repair an inconsistent pair, and a test shows the consistent one.

notes: V3 (Lei nº 5.988/1973) was not examined by any sweep (sweep-b's S-sweep-b-01 lists it among 'Dispositivo Correlato' rows not individually swept). g3b read Lei nº 9.610/1998 arts. 1º, 46 and 115 on Planalto on 2026-09-29 to answer it; nothing there changes the Code's text.
The phrase in art. 184 reads "os que lhe são conexos" (singular "lhe"); Lei nº 9.610, art. 1º, has "lhes". The difference is grammatical, not legal.

site.anchor: a violação de direitos de autor de programa de computador é crime da Lei nº 9.609, de 1998, que não está codificada

source.quote: Violar direitos de autor e os que lhe são conexos:

citations.cite: Lei nº 9.609/1998, art. 12: "Violar direitos de autor de programa de computador: Pena - Detenção de seis meses a dois anos ou multa."

readings.description: A computer program's author's rights are protected by their own crime, Lei nº 9.609/1998, art. 12, which displaces art. 184 by speciality (art. 12 of the Code). Art. 184 does not answer for a program, and the encoding, which does not contain Lei nº 9.609, refuses by name.

citations.cite: CP art. 12 (the Code's general rules apply to special laws "se esta não dispuser de modo diverso")

readings.description: Art. 184 applies to programs as to any work, Lei nº 9.609 notwithstanding.
readings.foreclosure: The special law describes the same conduct for the same object with its own penalty; the general law yields. Not refuted by any authority g3b read; no court decision was searched.

citations.cite: CP art. 184, caput — "Violar direitos de autor" names no class of work, so read alone it reaches a program

taken.rationale: Where the answer lies in a law the encoding does not contain, the honest shape is a named refusal (phrasebook entries 1.6 and 11.5), not FALSE: a program's violation is a crime, just not this article's. The gate is asserted directly in the tests.

witnesses: `a pirataria de programa de computador` — refuses under the taken reading; would be art. 184, § 1º under the other
notes: Not examined by sweep-b. For the conductor: Lei nº 9.609/1998 is outside the source bundle; its art. 12 was read only to name it.

site.anchor: o disposto nos §§ 1º, 2º e 3º não se aplica (art. 184, § 4º)

source.quote: O disposto nos §§ 1o, 2o e 3o não se aplica quando se tratar de exceção ou limitação ao direito de autor ou os que lhe são conexos, em conformidade com o previsto na Lei nº 9.610, de 19 de fevereiro de 1998, nem a cópia de obra intelectual ou fonograma, em um só exemplar, para uso privado do copista, sem intuito de lucro direto ou indireto.

readings.description: § 4º takes its two cases out of §§ 1º to 3º only, as it says. A single private copy of a whole work, without profit, is not § 1º; it remains the caput's violation wherever the copyright law finds it one (Lei nº 9.610/1998, art. 46, II, excepts only "a reprodução, em um só exemplar de pequenos trechos, para uso privado do copista").
§ 4º declares the single private copy without profit lawful altogether, so it is not the caput's crime either.
readings.foreclosure: The paragraph names §§ 1º, 2º and 3º and not the caput; and whether the copy is lawful is the copyright law's question, which answers it through the delegated finding (F-g3b-01). A court reading the paragraph as a policy of decriminalising private copying could adopt this reading.

citations.cite: CP art. 184, § 4º — "nem a cópia de obra intelectual ou fonograma, em um só exemplar, para uso privado do copista, sem intuito de lucro direto ou indireto", read as a statement of what is lawful

taken.rationale: The text's own scope. The second limb is then declaratory for §§ 1º to 3º, which all require profit; the tests assert it both ways (private copy with and without profit).

witnesses: `a cópia privada única de obra inteira` — caput (queixa) under the taken reading, no crime under the other

site.anchor: violação de direito autoral qualificada do art. 184, § 2º

source.quote: original ou cópia de obra intelectual ou fonograma reproduzido com violação do direito de autor, do direito de artista intérprete ou executante ou do direito do produtor de fonograma, ou, ainda, aluga original ou cópia de obra intelectual ou fonograma, sem a expressa autorização dos titulares dos direitos ou de quem os represente.

readings.description: "sem a expressa autorização" closes the rental limb ("ou, ainda, aluga ..."). The first limb is already qualified by "reproduzido com violação"; dealing in such a copy is § 2º whether or not the holder consents to the dealing.

citations.cite: CP art. 184, § 2º — the clause follows the second limb, after "ou, ainda,"

readings.description: "sem a expressa autorização" qualifies both limbs, so dealing with the holder's authorisation is never § 2º.

citations.cite: CP art. 184, § 2º, read as one period

taken.rationale: Placement: the clause sits after "ou, ainda,", which opens the second limb, and only that limb's object may be a lawful copy, for which authorisation is what separates a lawful rental from a crime. The first limb's object is unlawful by description. "com o intuito de lucro" governs both limbs, since both verbs hang on the one "quem".

witnesses: `a venda de cópia pirata autorizada pelo titular` — § 2º under the taken reading, not under the other
notes: The witness is a corner case: a holder who authorises the sale of copies reproduced in violation of their own right. It is recorded because the two readings do answer it differently.

source.quote: III – ação penal pública incondicionada, nos crimes cometidos em desfavor de entidades de direito público, autarquia, empresa pública, sociedade de economia mista ou fundação instituída pelo Poder Público;

site.anchor: mediante violência ou grave ameaça (arts. 197 a 199)

source.quote: Constranger alguém, mediante violência ou grave ameaça:

citations.cite: CP art. 203 — "Frustrar, mediante fraude ou violência"
CP art. 208, parágrafo único — "Se há emprego de violência"
CP art. 200 — "praticando violência contra pessoa ou contra coisa"

readings.description: "violência" alone is violence against a person. Violence against a thing is reached only where the text says so, as art. 200 does ("contra pessoa ou contra coisa").

citations.cite: CP art. 200 — the Code names "contra coisa" where it means it
CP arts. 197–199 — violence as a means of constraining a person

citations.cite: CP arts. 208 and 209, parágrafo único — "Se há emprego de violência", unqualified; "sem prejuízo da correspondente à violência" fits damage to a thing, which has its own offence (art. 163), as well as injury to a person

site.anchor: abandono coletivo (art. 200, parágrafo único)
provisions: CP art. 200, caput e parágrafo único

source.quote: Participar de suspensão ou abandono coletivo de trabalho

citations.cite: CP art. 200, parágrafo único — "Para que se considere coletivo o abandono de trabalho é indispensável o concurso de, pelo menos, três empregados."

readings.description: "coletivo" (masculine) agrees with "abandono" and not with "suspensão" (feminine): it is the abandonment, the employees' stoppage, that must be collective, and the parágrafo único defines only "coletivo o abandono". A suspension (the employer's stoppage) needs no count. The three employees include the agent where the agent is one of them.

citations.cite: CP art. 200, parágrafo único — speaks only of "o abandono de trabalho"

readings.description: "coletivo" qualifies both nouns, so a suspension too must involve at least three employees.
readings.rejection_rationale: It would need "coletiva" for "suspensão", and the parágrafo único counts employees, who do not make a suspension.

taken.rationale: The grammar and the parágrafo único's own words. The count is `número de empregados que concorreram para o abandono`, whose herald says the agent is included if an employee.
