site.anchor: participar de suspensão ou abandono coletivo de trabalho (arts. 200 e 201)

source.quote: Para que se considere coletivo o abandono de trabalho é indispensável o concurso de, pelo menos, três empregados.

citations.cite: CP art. 201 — "Participar de suspensão ou abandono coletivo de trabalho"

readings.description: The parágrafo único defines the phrase that arts. 200 and 201 share word for word, in adjacent articles of one Título; art. 201's "abandono coletivo" needs three employees too.

citations.cite: CP arts. 200 and 201 — the same words

readings.description: A parágrafo único belongs to its article; in art. 201 "coletivo" is an open standard for the judge.
readings.foreclosure: Reading the definition into art. 201 narrows the offence, so it is not an analogy against the accused; and the alternative leaves the same word of the same Título with two meanings. A court following topography strictly could adopt it.

citations.cite: CP art. 200, parágrafo único — placed in art. 200

taken.rationale: Same words, same Título, and the reading favours the accused.

witnesses: `a greve de dois no transporte` — not art. 201 under the taken reading; a question for the judge under the other

site.anchor: paralisação de trabalho seguida de violência do art. 200

source.quote: Participar de suspensão ou abandono coletivo de trabalho, praticando violência contra pessoa ou contra coisa:

readings.description: "praticando" has the participant as its subject: the one who practises the violence while taking part commits art. 200. Another participant is reached, if at all, as a co-author (art. 29).
Everyone who takes part in a stoppage during which violence occurs commits art. 200.
readings.rejection_rationale: The gerund attaches the violence to the one who participates; and criminal liability is personal.

taken.rationale: The means on `Fato` are the agent's own; a stoppage where only others were violent has no violence among the agent's means.

notes: The case record records only the agent's means, so the encoding cannot exhibit the other reading: the taken reading is carried by what the field records.

site.anchor: paralisação de trabalho de interesse coletivo do art. 201

source.quote: Participar de suspensão ou abandono coletivo de trabalho, provocando a interrupção de obra pública ou serviço de interesse coletivo:

citations.cite: CF art. 9º: "É assegurado o direito de greve, competindo aos trabalhadores decidir sobre a oportunidade de exercê-lo e sobre os interesses que devam por meio dele defender." (read on Planalto, 2026-09-29)

readings.description: Art. 201 applies as written: taking part in a collective stoppage that interrupts a public work or a service of collective interest is the crime, whether or not the strike is lawful under the strike law.

A strike exercised under the right to strike and within Lei nº 7.783/1989 (which, for essential services, requires the indispensable services to be kept up, art. 11) is lawful and outside art. 201; only abuse of the right (art. 14) and crimes committed in its course (art. 15) are punished.

citations.cite: Lei nº 7.783/1989, art. 14: "Constitui abuso do direito de greve a inobservância das normas contidas na presente Lei ..."; art. 15: "A responsabilidade pelos atos praticados, ilícitos ou crimes cometidos, no curso da greve, será apurada, conforme o caso, segundo a legislação trabalhista, civil ou penal." (read on Planalto, 2026-09-29)

readings.description: Art. 201 was not received by the 1988 Constitution, which guarantees the right to strike without the Code's limit.

taken.rationale: Encoded as the text stands so that the article is not silently dropped, and flagged OPEN: no binding authority was read either way, and the P2 sweep did not examine the question. The other two readings are the ones a court is likely to weigh.

witnesses: `a greve de três no transporte` — a peaceful strike interrupting a service of collective interest: art. 201 under the taken reading; lawful under the other two, if within Lei nº 7.783/1989
notes: For the conductor and sweep-b: whether an STF or STJ decision settles the reception of art. 201 (and of art. 200, whose violence keeps it outside the right to strike on any reading) was not searched. Lei nº 7.783/1989 and CF art. 9º were read only to cite them.

entries.delegated_field: `Fato de frustração de direito trabalhista`'s `frustração de direito assegurado pela legislação do trabalho`

site.anchor: frustração de direito trabalhista do art. 203, caput

source.quote: Frustrar, mediante fraude ou violência, direito assegurado pela legislação do trabalho:

readings.description: Art. 203 is a norma penal em branco: which rights the labour legislation assures is for that legislation (the CLT and the rest) to say. The encoding takes the finding that the conduct frustrated such a right.

citations.cite: CP art. 203 — "direito assegurado pela legislação do trabalho"

readings.description: Encode the rights of the labour legislation so that the finding is computed.
readings.rejection_rationale: Outside the source bundle and the brief.

taken.rationale: The Code points to another body of law for the right; the fact supplier applies it.

site.anchor: frustração de direito trabalhista do art. 203, § 1º, II

source.quote: II - impede alguém de se desligar de serviços de qualquer natureza, mediante coação ou por meio da retenção de seus documentos pessoais ou contratuais.

readings.description: "coação" is constraint by violence against the person or by a serious threat, the means the Code names for constraining someone elsewhere ("Constranger alguém, mediante violência ou grave ameaça", arts. 146 and 197–199).

citations.cite: CP arts. 197–199 — "mediante violência ou grave ameaça"

readings.description: "coação" covers any threat or pressure that keeps the worker from leaving, a plain threat included.

taken.rationale: The Code's own words for constraining a person; and the second means of the same inciso, the retention of documents, shows that the drafter listed a lesser means separately where it wanted one.

witnesses: `o desligamento impedido com ameaça simples` — not § 1º, II under the taken reading, § 1º, II under the other

site.anchor: vítima menor de dezoito anos, idosa, gestante, indígena ou portadora de deficiência física ou mental

source.quote: se a vítima é menor de dezoito anos, idosa, gestante, indígena ou portadora de deficiência física ou mental.

readings.description: "física ou mental" names two natures of disability and not a third: a sensory (visual or hearing) disability is not within them. "mental" includes what is now called intellectual disability, which was its name in 1998.

citations.cite: CF art. 227, § 1º, II, in its 1988 wording in force when Lei nº 9.777/1998 was enacted: "para os portadores de deficiência física, sensorial ou mental" — the constitutional vocabulary of the time counted three natures (read on Planalto, 2026-09-29)
A cause of increase is read strictly

readings.description: "deficiência física ou mental" means any disability; the purpose is to protect the vulnerable worker, and a blind or deaf worker is as vulnerable.

citations.cite: CP arts. 203 and 207, § 2º — the class the paragraph protects

taken.rationale: The words, read in the vocabulary of their time, in which the Constitution itself listed sensory disability separately; and a cause of increase is not extended by purpose. The shared noun `pessoa com deficiência` does not say which nature, so the case record for arts. 203 and 207 carries the nature (`Condição do trabalhador (arts. 203 e 207)`).

witnesses: `contra a trabalhadora cega` — no increase under the taken reading, one sixth to one third under the other

site.anchor: incide o aumento do art. 203, § 2º

source.quote: A pena é aumentada de um sexto a um terço se a vítima é menor de dezoito anos

readings.description: Where the crime has several victims, the increase applies if any of them is in the class.
The increase applies only if every victim is in the class.
readings.rejection_rationale: An adult co-victim would then remove the protection the paragraph gives the minor beside them.

taken.rationale: The paragraph protects each victim in the class; the encoding counts one crime per case, and how several crimes against several victims combine (arts. 69–71) is the judge's.

witnesses: `contra Ana e Bruno, antes dos dezoito dele` — increase under the taken reading, none under the other

site.anchor: trabalhadores, no plural (arts. 206 e 207)

source.quote: Recrutar trabalhadores, mediante fraude, com o fim de levá-los para território estrangeiro.

readings.description: The plural asks for two or more workers.
At least three, borrowing art. 200's number for a collective act of labour.
readings.foreclosure: Art. 200's number is for the collective abandonment of work, a different thing from recruiting; the plural itself says only "more than one".

citations.cite: CP art. 200, parágrafo único — "pelo menos, três empregados"

readings.description: The plural is generic, as in a definition; recruiting one worker suffices.

citations.cite: CP arts. 206 and 207 — the plural read as generic

taken.rationale: The words, and the Code states a larger number where it wants one (art. 200). Strict construction of the type.

witnesses: `o recrutamento enganoso de uma só` — not art. 206 under the taken reading, art. 206 under `umBasta`

site.anchor: recrutamento de trabalhadores do art. 207, § 1º

source.quote: Incorre na mesma pena quem recrutar trabalhadores fora da localidade de execução do trabalho, dentro do território nacional, mediante fraude ou cobrança de qualquer quantia do trabalhador, ou, ainda, não assegurar condições do seu retorno ao local de origem.

readings.description: "não assegurar condições do seu retorno" is a third mode of the recruitment: the one who recruited workers away from the place of work and does not assure their return.

citations.cite: CP art. 207, § 1º — one "quem", and "seu retorno" is the recruited workers'

readings.description: It is a conduct of its own: anyone (the employer who received the workers, for instance) who does not assure their return commits § 1º.

citations.cite: CP art. 207, § 1º — "ou, ainda," read as opening a second conduct

taken.rationale: "seu retorno ao local de origem" presupposes workers brought from elsewhere by a recruitment, and the sentence has one subject.

notes: The case record describes the recruiter's conduct, so the encoding cannot exhibit the other reading, which would reach a person who recruited no one.

entries.delegated_field: `Fato de frustração de lei sobre a nacionalização do trabalho`'s `frustração de obrigação legal relativa à nacionalização do trabalho`

site.anchor: frustração de lei sobre a nacionalização do trabalho do art. 204

source.quote: Frustrar, mediante fraude ou violência, obrigação legal relativa à nacionalização do trabalho:

readings.description: Which legal obligations relate to the nationalisation of labour is for the law imposing them (the labour legislation's rules on the nationalisation of labour) to say; the encoding takes the finding.
Encode the obligations so that the finding is computed.
readings.rejection_rationale: Outside the source bundle and the brief.

taken.rationale: The Code points outside itself for the obligation.

notes: Whether the labour legislation's nationalisation rules survive the 1988 Constitution's equality between Brazilians and resident foreigners is a question for a lawyer; if they do not, there is no obligation to frustrate, and the finding is FALSE.

site.anchor: exercício de atividade com infração de decisão administrativa do art. 205

source.quote: Exercer atividade, de que está impedido por decisão administrativa:

readings.description: "Exercer atividade" is the continued practice of an activity: one act is not exercising it, and the crime is habitual, with no attempt.

citations.cite: CP art. 282 — "Exercer, ainda que a título gratuito, a profissão de médico ...", the Code's other "exercer" of an occupation

readings.description: A single act of the activity is exercising it.

citations.cite: CP art. 205 — the verb read literally

taken.rationale: An activity is exercised by practising it; a single act is an act, not an activity. No authority was read; the reading is the encoder's.

witnesses: `o médico suspenso que atende uma vez` — not art. 205 under the taken reading, art. 205 under the other

site.anchor: destruição, subtração ou ocultação de cadáver do art. 211

source.quote: Destruir, subtrair ou ocultar cadáver ou parte dele:

citations.cite: CP art. 212 — "Vilipendiar cadáver ou suas cinzas:"

readings.description: Each article reaches only the objects it names: art. 211 the corpse or a part of it, not the ashes; art. 212 the corpse or its ashes, not a part.

citations.cite: CP arts. 211 and 212 — adjacent articles of one Capítulo, each naming a different extension of "cadáver"
CP art. 1º — no crime without a prior law defining it

readings.description: A corpse's parts and ashes are the corpse; "parte dele" and "suas cinzas" are each for the avoidance of doubt, and both articles reach all three.

citations.cite: CP arts. 211 and 212, read by their purpose, the respect owed to the dead

taken.rationale: The two articles were drafted together and name different objects; reading each as naming everything makes one of the two phrases idle, and the extension would be against the accused.

witnesses: `as cinzas ocultadas` — not art. 211 under the taken reading
`a parte do cadáver vilipendiada` — not art. 212 under the taken reading

site.anchor: a vigência da redação atual dos arts. 184 e 186

source.quote: (Redação dada pela Lei nº 10.695, de 1º.7.2003)

citations.cite: Lei nº 10.695/2003, art. 5º: "Esta Lei entra em vigor 30 (trinta) dias após a sua publicação."; published DOU 2.7.2003 (Planalto's footer; Senado metadata datapub 02/07/2003)

readings.description: Counted as LC nº 95/1998, art. 8º, § 1º counts a vacatio: the day of publication and the last day both included, in force the day after. 2.7.2003 is day 1, 31.7.2003 day 30, so in force on 1.8.2003.

citations.cite: LC nº 95/1998, art. 8º, § 1o (incluído pela LC nº 107/2001): "A contagem do prazo para entrada em vigor das leis que estabeleçam período de vacância far-se-á com a inclusão da data da publicação e do último dia do prazo, entrando em vigor no dia subseqüente à sua consumação integral." (read on Planalto, 2026-09-29)

readings.description: Thirty days counted from the day after publication (3.7.2003 to 1.8.2003), in force on 2.8.2003.
readings.rejection_rationale: LC nº 95/1998, art. 8º, § 1º, in force since 2001, includes the day of publication in the count.

taken.rationale: The statutory rule for counting a vacatio, in force since 2001 and so before Lei nº 10.695/2003 was published. LC nº 95/1998 is outside the source bundle; its art. 8º, § 1o was read on Planalto.

witnesses: `a violação simples no dia da vigência` (1.8.2003) — decided; `a violação simples na véspera da vigência` (31.7.2003) — refuses
notes: The other two amending laws in g3b's range took effect on publication: Lei nº 9.777/1998 (arts. 203 and 207; DOU 30.12.1998) and Lei nº 8.683/1993 (art. 206; DOU 16.7.1993), each read on Planalto on 2026-09-29.

entries.delegated_field: `Ato contra o respeito aos mortos`'s objeto, member `cadáver`

site.anchor: Objeto do ato contra o respeito aos mortos

source.quote: cadáver

readings.description: A "cadáver" is the body of a dead human being, a stillborn child's included.

citations.cite: CP arts. 211 and 212 — the respect owed to the dead does not depend on having been born alive

readings.description: Only the body of one who was born alive and died is a "cadáver".

taken.rationale: The herald of the member `cadáver` states it, so the fact supplier classifies accordingly. No authority was read; recorded because a reviewer will ask.

entries.delegated_field: `Fato de ultraje a culto`'s `escárnio de alguém`

site.anchor: escárnio por motivo religioso do art. 208

source.quote: Escarnecer de alguém publicamente, por motivo de crença ou função religiosa;

readings.description: "alguém" is a particular person, mocked because of their own belief or religious office.

citations.cite: CP art. 208 — "de alguém", as in "Constranger alguém" (arts. 146, 197)

readings.description: Mocking a religion, or its faithful in general, is enough.
readings.rejection_rationale: The text says "alguém"; the same article's third figure reaches what is directed at the worship itself (its acts and objects), so the first need not stretch to cover it.

taken.rationale: The field is named and glossed for a particular person.

site.anchor: aliciamento de trabalhadores do art. 207, caput

source.quote: Aliciar trabalhadores, com o fim de levá-los de uma para outra localidade do território nacional:

readings.description: "aliciar" (to entice) and "recrutar" (to recruit) are different conducts. Recruiting to move workers within the country is § 1º's, and only with its conditions (away from the place of work, and fraud, charging, or no assured return).

citations.cite: CP art. 207, § 1º, added in 1998 with the caput's own penalty

readings.description: "aliciar" includes any recruiting, so any recruiting to move workers within the country is the caput's.

taken.rationale: If "aliciar" included recruiting, § 1º — which punishes recruiting only under stated conditions, with the same penalty — would add nothing. A provision is not read as idle when a reading gives it work.

witnesses: `o recrutamento sem aliciamento para outro estado` — not art. 207 under the taken reading, the caput under the other

site.anchor: Fato de constrangimento contra a organização do trabalho

source.quote: Constranger alguém, mediante violência ou grave ameaça

readings.description: The crime is consummated when the victim does, or refrains from, what the agent constrained them to; violence or a threat that did not bend the victim is an attempt.

citations.cite: CP arts. 197–199 — "Constranger alguém ... a": the constraint is to a result

readings.description: The crime is consummated when the violence or serious threat is used to that end, whether or not the victim gives in.

citations.cite: CP arts. 197–199 — "Constranger ... mediante violência ou grave ameaça", read as the use of the means

taken.rationale: "Constranger alguém a" names the result the constraint aims at; until the victim gives in, the agent has tried to constrain. The case record's herald for the stage of execution says so, so the fact supplier records a victim who resisted as `execução interrompida por circunstâncias alheias à vontade do agente`.

witnesses: `a não exercer o ofício, tentado` — an attempt (reduced by one to two thirds) under the taken reading, consummated under the other

site.anchor: As leis que deram ao Título VI a sua redação
provisions: CP arts. 213 to 249: every rule gated by the vigência of the law that gave its words their current form

source.quote: Art. 28. Esta lei entrará em vigor 30 (trinta) dias depois de sua publicação.

citations.cite: Lei nº 5.478/1968, art. 28 (DOU 26.7.1968, retificado em 14.8.1968 e republicado em 8.4.1974), as read by sweep-c, S-sweep-c-18
LINDB, art. 1º, §§ 3º e 4º, as quoted by sweep-c, S-sweep-c-18
Leis nº 15.280/2025 (8.12.2025) and 15.353/2026 (8.3.2026): in force on publication, sweep-c S-sweep-c-04

readings.description: Lei nº 5.478/1968's rectification of 14.8.1968, published inside its thirty-day vacatio, restarted the count (LINDB art. 1º, § 3º): in force 13.9.1968.

citations.cite: LINDB art. 1º, § 3º: 'Se, antes de entrar a lei em vigor, ocorrer nova publicação de seu texto, destinada a correção, o prazo ... começará a correr da nova publicação.'

readings.description: The thirty days ran from the original publication: in force 25.8.1968.
readings.foreclosure: Whether the rectification was a 'nova publicação destinada a correção' of the provisions in question is not established (S-sweep-c-18 did not compare the texts). The encoding refuses for a fact between 25.8 and 12.9.1968 rather than choose.

taken.rationale: Answer only where both readings agree: art. 244's penalty and parágrafo único answer from 13.9.1968 and refuse before. Every other law's date is settled by its own clause, read by sweep-c. Not established either way: whether the 1974 republication corrected art. 244 (LINDB art. 1º, § 4º would make a corrected provision date from 8.4.1974); no fact of 1968-1974 under art. 244 is live.

witnesses: cp-g4a-assistencia-familiar-testes.l4: `o devedor de pensão que a frustra, em` 13.9.1968 (answers) against 12.9.1968 (refuses)
notes: The rule the whole encoding follows: a rule answers for a fact from the vigência of the law that gave its words their current form. Before it: where the law ADDED a provision that replaced nothing in the Code, the provision is not law and the rule says so as an ordinary value; where it REPLACED earlier words, those govern and are not in the source, so the rule refuses by name.

The dates were first taken from the Senado record's DOU dates and the encoder's recollection of two vacatio clauses; sweep-c confirmed every one on 2026-09-29 (S-sweep-c-18) save Lei nº 5.478/1968, which it found to be 25.8.1968 or 13.9.1968 rather than the publication day.

site.anchor: crime de estupro (art. 213)

source.quote: Constranger alguém, mediante violência ou grave ameaça, a ter conjunção carnal ou a praticar ou permitir que com ele se pratique outro ato libidinoso

citations.cite: CP art. 215-A ("se o ato não constitui crime mais grave")

readings.description: One act within the words of several articles is ONE crime: art. 217-A (vulnerable victim) prevails by specialty over arts. 213 and 215; art. 213 over art. 215, the graver where violence or threat was used too; art. 215-A yields to any graver crime by its own words. Likewise art. 218 over art. 227 for a victim under fourteen, art. 218-B over art. 228 for one under eighteen or without discernment, and art. 235 over art. 237 where the known impediment is a marriage.

citations.cite: CP art. 215-A, preceito: 'se o ato não constitui crime mais grave'
CP art. 217-A: the vulnerable victim is the specialising element

readings.description: Each article applies on its own words, the court resolving the concurrence of offences.
readings.rejection_rationale: A single act against a single legal interest is not several crimes; the special provision's extra element (the victim's vulnerability or age) states the whole of the general one.

taken.rationale: Each exported predicate answers whether ITS crime is the one the facts make out; the literal 'os elementos ... estão reunidos' predicates remain for a reader who wants the words alone.

witnesses: cp-g4a-liberdade-sexual-testes.l4: `violência contra Carla` (art. 217-A, not art. 213, though the words of art. 213 are met)
cp-g4a-liberdade-sexual-testes.l4: `fraude e violência` (art. 213, not art. 215)
cp-g4a-lenocinio-testes.l4: `Carla induzida` (not art. 227)
notes: Where the agent's own violence makes the victim unable to resist, whether the case is art. 213 or art. 217-A, § 1º ('por qualquer outra causa') depends on how the fact supplier records the victim's condition; the encoding follows the condition as recorded. A Brazilian criminal lawyer should confirm the line.

site.anchor: o art. 226 alcança o crime
provisions: CP art. 226, caput, I, II and IV

source.quote: Art. 226. A pena é aumentada: I – de quarta parte, se o crime é cometido com o concurso de 2 (duas) ou mais pessoas; ... IV - de 1/3 (um terço) a 2/3 (dois terços), se o crime é praticado: Estupro coletivo a) mediante concurso de 2 (dois) ou mais agentes; Estupro corretivo b) para controlar o comportamento social ou sexual da vítima.

citations.cite: CP art. 226 (redação das Leis nº 11.106/2005 e 13.718/2018)
CP Título VI, Capítulo IV — Disposições gerais

readings.description: Art. 226 reaches the crimes of the chapters before its Disposições gerais (I, I-A, II); inciso IV, whose alíneas carry the rubrics 'Estupro coletivo' and 'Estupro corretivo', reaches estupro (arts. 213 and 217-A), and there IV, a displaces I, which states the same concurso with a smaller fraction.

citations.cite: CP art. 226, IV, rubricas 'Estupro coletivo', 'Estupro corretivo'

readings.description: Inciso IV reaches every crime of Capítulos I, I-A and II like the other incisos, and IV, a displaces I wherever both are met.

citations.cite: CP art. 226, IV: 'se o crime é praticado' (no crime named)

readings.foreclosure: Under the counting of F-g0-26 'duas ou mais pessoas' and 'dois ou mais agentes' coincide, so inciso I would never apply; the rubrics name estupro.

readings.description: I and IV, a apply together to the same concurso.

citations.cite: CP art. 226, I and IV, a

readings.rejection_rationale: One circumstance, two increases: bis in idem.

readings.description: Art. 226 reaches every crime of Título VI, Capítulos V and VI included.
readings.rejection_rationale: Capítulo V states its own relational qualified forms (arts. 227 § 1º, 228 § 1º, 230 § 1º), which art. 226, II would double; art. 234-A, which does reach the whole Título, says so ('neste Título') and art. 226 does not.

taken.rationale: The placement fixes the chapters; the rubrics fix inciso IV; the displacement of I by IV, a keeps both incisos operative. Not settled by any authority the sweep found; a court could read IV as reaching every crime of Capítulos I and II.

witnesses: cp-g4a-dignidade-sexual-geral-testes.l4: `estupro a dois` (IV, not I) against `corrupção a dois` (I)
cp-g4a-dignidade-sexual-geral-testes.l4: `fraude corretiva` (no IV for art. 215)
cp-g4a-dignidade-sexual-geral-testes.l4: `mediação a dois` (Capítulo V not reached)

site.anchor: definido nos Capítulos I e II do Título VI (art. 225)

source.quote: Art. 225. Nos crimes definidos nos Capítulos I e II deste Título, procede-se mediante ação penal pública incondicionada.

readings.description: Capítulo I-A (art. 216-B), added after art. 225 was re-worded, is not named; art. 100 decides its ação penal (public and unconditioned, the law requiring no representation).
Capítulo I-A is part of the 'Capítulo I' sequence and art. 225 reaches it.

citations.cite: CP Título VI, Capítulo I-A (Lei nº 13.772/2018)

readings.foreclosure: Art. 225 names two chapters; Lei nº 13.772/2018 created a new one and did not amend art. 225. Both readings give a public, unconditioned prosecution.

notes: cp-g4a-dignidade-sexual-geral-testes.l4 asserts that `a ação penal do art. 225` of art. 216-B is NOTHING (art. 100 decides).

site.anchor: Art. 234-A — Aumento de pena

site.anchor: Art. 234-B — Segredo de justiça

source.quote: § 3º O réu condenado passará a ser monitorado por dispositivo eletrônico.

readings.description: §§ 1º-2º (publicity of the conviction) reach a first-instance conviction given from 28.11.2024; § 3º (electronic monitoring), a burden on the convicted person, reaches a fact committed from that day.

source.quote: Art. 258 - Se do crime doloso de perigo comum resulta lesão corporal de natureza grave, a pena privativa de liberdade é aumentada de metade; se resulta morte, é aplicada em dobro.

citations.cite: CP art. 258, rubric "Formas qualificadas de crime de perigo comum"

readings.description: Three arms are fractions ("aumentada de metade", "em dobro"): causes of increase applied in art. 68's third phase to the crime's own preceito; the fourth replaces the preceito (homicídio culposo's) and adds a third.
Each arm is a qualified form with new limits of its own (e.g. 6 to 12 years for arson with a death), read as the preceito.
readings.foreclosure: The text states fractions, not limits; the outer limits come out the same either way (`os limites da pena ... com as causas`).

site.anchor: incide o aumento do art. 327, § 2º

source.quote: quando os autores dos crimes previstos neste Capítulo forem ocupantes de cargos em comissão ou de função de direção ou assessoramento

readings.description: The increase reaches the crimes of Capítulo I only (arts. 312 to 326, 313-A, 313-B and 319-A included), and each author who personally holds such a post; a co-author who holds none is not reached.
It reaches every crime against the administration committed by such an officer.
readings.rejection_rationale: 'neste Capítulo' confines it to Capítulo I, where art. 327 sits.

readings.description: Once one author holds such a post, the increase reaches every author.
readings.foreclosure: A post held is a personal circumstance, not an element of the crime, so art. 30 keeps it from passing to a co-author; a court could read 'os autores' collectively.

taken.rationale: The words 'neste Capítulo' and art. 30. Only Capítulo I's rules call the increase, and a case record has one agent.

site.anchor: os elementos do art. 313

source.quote: CAPÍTULO I DOS CRIMES PRATICADOS POR FUNCIONÁRIO PÚBLICO CONTRA A ADMINISTRAÇÃO EM GERAL

citations.cite: CP, Parte Especial, Título XI, Capítulo I, heading

readings.description: Where an article of Capítulo I does not name its agent (arts. 313, 314, 315, 318, 319, 326), or names him as 'quem' (art. 325 § 1º) or 'agente público' (art. 319-A), the agent is a funcionário público under art. 327, as the chapter's heading says.
Where the article's own words do not require a funcionário — most plainly art. 326 ('Devassar o sigilo de proposta de concorrência pública') — anyone can commit it.
readings.foreclosure: A heading is part of the enacted text and places every article under it; most of these articles also speak of 'cargo', 'ato de ofício' or 'dever funcional'. Art. 326 is the one whose words would reach a private person.

taken.rationale: The heading is enacted text and every other article of the chapter presupposes an official; the arguable reading matters in practice only for art. 326.

cp-g6a-corrupcao-passiva-a-sigilo-testes.l4: `a proposta devassada pelo particular`

site.anchor: tentado (art. 14, II)

source.quote: tentado, quando, iniciada a execução, não se consuma por circunstâncias alheias à vontade do agente

readings.description: An attempt is modelled where the conduct can be begun and stopped from outside: the intentional commissive forms. Not for the culpable form (art. 312 § 2º), nor for the omissions and one-act conducts (arts. 317 § 2º, 319, 319-A, 320, 323, 330, 331, 337-A).
Art. 14, II is general, so every crime has an attempted form.
readings.rejection_rationale: A want of care has no execution to interrupt, and an omission is either made or not; 'circunstâncias alheias à vontade' presupposes a willed result.

taken.rationale: The ordinary doctrine on art. 14, stated per article in the modules' headers. Arts. 330 and 331 are the debatable ones (a written disobedience or insult can be intercepted).

witnesses: cp-g6a-peculato-a-concussao-testes.l4: `a apropriação tentada` (attempt, reduced) and `a apropriação abandonada` (no crime)
cp-g6a-usurpacao-a-corrupcao-ativa-testes.l4: `a resistência tentada`
notes: Where an article punishes the attempt as the crime itself (art. 335, 'procurar afastar'), see F-g6a-18.

site.anchor: os elementos do art. 312, caput

source.quote: Apropriar-se o funcionário público de dinheiro, valor ou qualquer outro bem móvel, público ou particular, de que tem a posse em razão do cargo, ou desviá-lo, em proveito próprio ou alheio:

readings.description: 'em proveito próprio ou alheio' qualifies both the appropriation and the diversion.
It qualifies only 'desviá-lo', which it follows; appropriation needs no stated benefit.
readings.foreclosure: The comma sets the phrase off from 'desviá-lo', and appropriating a thing is making it one's own, which is already a benefit to oneself or another; the readings differ only on an appropriation with no benefit to anyone.

taken.rationale: The comma, and § 1º's parallel 'em proveito próprio ou alheio' after both its verbs.

site.anchor: a multa aplicada cabe na pena cominada do Capítulo II-B (arts. 58 e 337-P)

source.quote: A pena de multa cominada aos crimes previstos neste Capítulo seguirá a metodologia de cálculo prevista neste Código e não poderá ser inferior a 2% (dois por cento) do valor do contrato licitado ou celebrado com contratação direta.

citations.cite: CP art. 49 — "no máximo, de 360 (trezentos e sessenta) dias-multa"; § 1º — "nem superior a 5 (cinco) vezes esse salário"

readings.description: Where 2% of the contract exceeds the largest fine art. 49 allows, the floor governs: art. 337-P is later and special, and says the fine "não poderá ser inferior".

citations.cite: CP art. 337-P — "não poderá ser inferior a 2%"

readings.description: The fine follows "a metodologia de cálculo prevista neste Código", whose ceiling is art. 49's (trebled at most by art. 60, § 1º); the floor gives way above it.

citations.cite: CP art. 337-P — "seguirá a metodologia de cálculo prevista neste Código"

taken.rationale: Recorded, not built in (status open): where the two can both be met the combined check requires both; where the floor exceeds art. 49's largest fine the check REFUSES, naming the conflict, and decides neither reading. For a minimum wage of R$ 1.500 the conflict begins with contracts above R$ 135 million.

witnesses: cp-g6b-licitacoes-testes.l4: a contract of R$ 200 million (floor R$ 4 million) against art. 49's largest fine of R$ 2,7 million at a R$ 1.500 minimum wage — the combined check is REFUSED
notes: A double bind in the enacted text: for a large enough contract no fine satisfies both art. 337-P and art. 49 as art. 58 applies it. Art. 60, § 1º (g1b's) lets the judge treble the fine for a wealthy defendant, which moves the point of conflict (to contracts above R$ 405 million at the same wage) but does not remove it.

site.anchor: a ação penal do art. 345

source.quote: Parágrafo único - Se não há emprego de violência, somente se procede mediante queixa.

citations.cite: CP art. 337-K — "por meio de violência, grave ameaça, fraude ou oferecimento de vantagem"
CP art. 358 — "por meio de violência, grave ameaça, fraude ou oferecimento de vantagem"

readings.description: "violência" is violence against a person: the one removed from the tender or auction, or the one the agent takes the law into their own hands against. Violence against a thing does not count.

citations.cite: CP arts. 337-K, 345, 358 — each preceito adds "além da pena correspondente à violência", the penalty of an offence against the person
CP art. 352 — "usando de violência contra a pessoa"

readings.description: Any violence, to a person or to a thing, counts: breaking a lock in art. 345 makes the prosecution public.

taken.rationale: The rules read cp-dominio's `violência à pessoa` and not `violência contra coisa`; tests: removing a bidder by violence against a thing is not art. 337-K, and a creditor who forced a garage door keeps art. 345's queixa.

witnesses: cp-g6b-justica-exercicio-arbitrario-a-desobediencia-testes.l4: `o credor que arrombou a garagem` — ação penal privada under the taken reading, NOTHING (public) under the other
cp-g6b-licitacoes-testes.l4: removing a bidder with only `violência contra coisa` is not art. 337-K
notes: The second reading's own argument is the bare word: the parágrafo único says "violência" and not "violência contra a pessoa", as art. 352 does. The taken reading rests on the preceito's "pena correspondente à violência" and is contestable.

site.anchor: tentativa pelos fatos da execução (art. 14, II)
provisions: CP art. 14, II and parágrafo único

source.quote: Parágrafo único - Salvo disposição em contrário, pune-se a tentativa com a pena correspondente ao crime consumado, diminuída de um a dois terços.

citations.cite: CP art. 14, II e parágrafo único

readings.description: Every offence of the range takes an attempt under art. 14 where its execution can begin and be stopped short; none where the article punishes the attempt as the crime ("afastar ou tentar afastar", art. 337-K; "evadir-se ou tentar evadir-se", art. 352; "afastar ou procurar afastar", art. 358), where the crime is a pure omission ("deixar de restituir", art. 356; "Deixar de ordenar", art. 359-F), where the result that consummates it is also its condition (art. 337-G: nothing brought about, nothing to invalidate), or where the conduct and the result are one event (art. 354, the riot and the disturbance) — and none for the negligent form of art. 351, § 4º.

citations.cite: CP art. 14, II — "iniciada a execução, não se consuma"
CP arts. 337-K, 352, 358 — the attempt written into the preceito

readings.description: Art. 14 applies to every crime, so every offence of the range carries an attempted form.
readings.rejection_rationale: Where the preceito punishes the attempt as the crime, art. 14's "Salvo disposição em contrário" excludes the reduction; a pure omission has no execution to stop short; a culpable crime has no intent to carry through.

citations.cite: CP art. 14, parágrafo único — "Salvo disposição em contrário"

taken.rationale: Each offence's module says in a comment where no attempt is encoded, and why. The attempted forms elsewhere are built with `tentativa pelos fatos da execução (art. 14, II)` and reduced by cp-pena's `diminuição pela tentativa (art. 14, parágrafo único)`.

notes: Whether an attempt is possible in several formal crimes here (false testimony, art. 342; exploração de prestígio, art. 357) is debated in doctrine; the encoding admits it wherever the facts can describe an execution begun and stopped from outside, and a court that denies it for an offence need only never find `consumação impedida`.

site.anchor: imputando-lhe crime, infração ético-disciplinar, ato ímprobo ou contravenção (art. 339, caput e § 2º)

source.quote: § 2º - A pena é diminuída de metade, se a imputação é de prática de contravenção.

citations.cite: CP art. 339, caput — "imputando-lhe crime, infração ético-disciplinar ou ato ímprobo"

readings.description: § 2º presupposes that falsely accusing someone of a contravenção, and so causing a proceeding against them, is the crime of art. 339; it is the privileged form, with half the penalty.

citations.cite: CP art. 339, § 2º — "se a imputação é de prática de contravenção"

readings.description: The caput names crime, ético-disciplinar infraction and ato ímprobo only; an accusation of a contravenção is not the crime, and § 2º decides no case.
readings.rejection_rationale: It leaves § 2º with no case to apply to; a paragraph is not read to be void when a reading gives it work.

taken.rationale: `Imputação` has a `imputação de contravenção` member that makes out the crime and triggers the § 2º reduction, which applies only where nothing but a contravenção was imputed.

notes: § 2º is 1940 text; the caput was re-worded by Leis 10.028/2000 and 14.110/2020 and never named the contravenção, so the tension is old.

site.anchor: o falso testemunho é punível (art. 342, § 2º)

source.quote: § 2o O fato deixa de ser punível se, antes da sentença no processo em que ocorreu o ilícito, o agente se retrata ou declara a verdade.

readings.description: The retraction makes the false testimony of art. 342 unpunishable; it does not reach the one who bribed the witness (art. 343), whose article has no such paragraph.

citations.cite: CP art. 343 — no paragraph on retraction
CP art. 107, VI — retraction extinguishes punishability "nos casos em que a lei a admite"

readings.description: "O fato deixa de ser punível": the fact, not the agent, ceases to be punishable, so the retraction benefits everyone who took part in the false testimony, the briber included.

citations.cite: CP art. 342, § 2º — "O fato deixa de ser punível"

readings.foreclosure: Art. 343 is a separate crime with its own preceito, and art. 107, VI admits retraction only where the law provides for it; art. 343 provides for none. Participation in art. 342 itself (art. 29) is a different question the encoding does not model.

taken.rationale: Only art. 342's record carries the retraction field, and `o falso testemunho é punível (art. 342, § 2º)` is the only rule that reads it.

notes: Which sentence "antes da sentença no processo em que ocorreu o ilícito" names (the judgment in the proceeding where the false statement was made, not in the prosecution for it; in a jury trial, the jury's verdict or the pronúncia) is carried by the input field `retratou-se ou declarou a verdade antes da sentença no processo em que ocorreu o ilícito`, which the fact supplier certifies.

site.anchor: é processo administrativo

source.quote: como testemunha, perito, contador, tradutor ou intérprete em processo judicial, ou administrativo, inquérito policial, ou em juízo arbitral:

citations.cite: CP art. 339, caput — names "procedimento investigatório criminal" and "inquérito civil" beside "processo administrativo disciplinar"

readings.description: The procedimento investigatório criminal and the inquérito civil, the public prosecution's investigations, are not "processo administrativo": false testimony in them is not art. 342, nor coercion in them art. 344.

citations.cite: CP art. 339, caput (redação de 2020) — the legislator names these investigations separately when it means them

readings.description: The prosecution's investigations are administrative procedures in a broad sense and fall under "processo ... administrativo".
readings.foreclosure: Art. 339 was re-worded in 2020 to add both investigations by name beside the disciplinary proceeding, which would have been unnecessary if they were already administrative proceedings; arts. 342 (2001) and 344 (1940) were not.

taken.rationale: `é processo administrativo` answers FALSE for both; tested at arts. 342 and 344.

notes: This reading leaves a gap a court may well close: a witness who lies in a prosecutor's investigation. It is the text's gap, recorded rather than filled.

site.anchor: aumento do art. 342, § 1º

source.quote: § 1o As penas aumentam-se de um sexto a um terço, se o crime é praticado mediante suborno ou se cometido com o fim de obter prova destinada a produzir efeito em processo penal, ou em processo civil em que for parte entidade da administração pública direta ou indireta.

citations.cite: CP art. 347, parágrafo único — "as penas aplicam-se em dobro"
CP art. 357, parágrafo único — "As penas aumentam-se de um terço"

readings.description: "As penas", plural: the increase reaches the fine as well as the custodial penalty; the court scales the number of dias-multa by the same fraction.

citations.cite: CP arts. 342 § 1º, 343 p.ú., 347 p.ú., 357 p.ú. — "as penas"

readings.description: The increase changes the custodial range only; the fine is fixed within art. 49's limits by art. 60's criteria.

citations.cite: CP art. 58 — "A multa ... tem os limites fixados no art. 49"

taken.rationale: Taken as the text's reading, and not built into a number: `a pena cominada com a causa` (cp-pena, fork F-g0-28) scales the custodial range only and `Cominação da multa` carries no amount, so the encoding computes no number of dias-multa either way; where the increase lands on the fine is for the court applying arts. 49 and 60.

notes: Where the singular appears ("A pena é aumentada", art. 339 § 1º; "A pena aumenta-se", art. 344 p.ú.; "aplica-se em dobro a pena", art. 337-O § 2º) the question does not arise on the words. g0's F-g0-28 left each article whose words reach the fine to its encoder; this is g6b's answer for its four.

site.anchor: fica isento de pena (art. 348, § 2º)

source.quote: § 2º - Se quem presta o auxílio é ascendente, descendente, cônjuge ou irmão do criminoso, fica isento de pena.

readings.description: As written: the spouse is exempt, the partner in a stable union is not.
The exemption reaches the companheiro or companheira by analogy in the accused's favour, the Constitution protecting the stable union as a family entity.

citations.cite: Constituição Federal, art. 226, § 3º (recognising the união estável) — not in the source bundle

taken.rationale: Encoded as written, the task being to encode each clause as worded; the record's `Relação com o criminoso favorecido` has a `companheiro do criminoso` member so the difference is visible and tested (not exempt).

witnesses: cp-g6b-justica-exercicio-arbitrario-a-desobediencia-testes.l4: `a companheira que esconde o companheiro` — not exempt as written; exempt under incluiCompanheiro
notes: Analogy in bonam partem is generally admitted in penal law and the second reading may well be the courts'; no decision was read. An open question for a Brazilian criminal lawyer (notes/g6b.md).

site.anchor: ao crime é cominada pena de reclusão (art. 348)

source.quote: Auxiliar a subtrair-se à ação de autoridade pública autor de crime a que é cominada pena de reclusão:

citations.cite: CP art. 348, § 1º — "Se ao crime não é cominada pena de reclusão"
CP art. 306, parágrafo único — "Pena - reclusão ou detenção, de um a três anos, e multa"

readings.description: A crime whose preceito leaves the judge to choose between reclusão and detenção is one "a que é cominada pena de reclusão": reclusão is among the penalties it prescribes.
Only a crime whose preceito prescribes reclusão alone takes the caput; one with "reclusão ou detenção" is "não ... cominada pena de reclusão" and takes § 1º.

taken.rationale: The favoured person's crime arrives as its `Preceito secundário`; `reclusão ou detenção` counts as reclusão cominada (tested). The two readings differ only for arts. 235, § 1º and 306, parágrafo único.

witnesses: cp-g6b-justica-exercicio-arbitrario-a-desobediencia-testes.l4: `esconder o autor de um crime de reclusão ou detenção` — the caput's pena under the taken reading, § 1º's under the other

site.anchor: fuga qualificada do art. 351, § 1º

source.quote: § 1º - Se o crime é praticado a mão armada, ou por mais de uma pessoa, ou mediante arrombamento, a pena é de reclusão, de dois a seis anos.

readings.description: "a mão armada": with any weapon — a firearm of either kind, a blade, or another object used as a weapon.

citations.cite: CP art. 351, § 1º — "a mão armada", with no qualifier

readings.description: Only a weapon made as one (a firearm or a blade); an object used as a weapon does not make the escape armed.

taken.rationale: The rule reads all four of cp-dominio's weapon members; g0's note on `Meio empregado` leaves which count, for an unqualified "arma", to each group's fork.

witnesses: cp-g6b-justica-exercicio-arbitrario-a-desobediencia-testes.l4: `a fuga com um pedaço de pau` — § 1º's pena under the taken reading, the caput's under the other

site.anchor: funcionário pelos fatos do art. 327

source.quote: § 4º - No caso de culpa do funcionário incumbido da custódia ou guarda, aplica-se a pena de detenção, de três meses a um ano, ou multa.

citations.cite: CP art. 327, caput — "Considera-se funcionário público, para os efeitos penais, quem, embora transitoriamente ou sem remuneração, exerce cargo, emprego ou função pública"

CP art. 327, § 1º — "Equipara-se a funcionário público quem exerce cargo, emprego ou função em entidade paraestatal, e quem trabalha para empresa prestadora de serviço contratada ou conveniada para a execução de atividade típica da Administração Pública"

readings.description: "funcionário" is art. 327's funcionário público, the equiparados of § 1º included: a guard employed by a company contracted to run the custody is one.

citations.cite: CP art. 327, caput — "para os efeitos penais"; § 1º has no chapter limit

readings.description: Only one who holds a public office, post or function; the § 1º equiparação reaches the crimes of Capítulo I and not art. 351.

citations.cite: CP art. 327 sits at the end of Capítulo I

taken.rationale: Art. 327 is g6a's; it is not imported. `funcionário pelos fatos do art. 327` reads the same cp-dominio facts art. 327 reads (the caput's and § 1º's), with a comment naming art. 327, as PLAN § 6 asks. Unlike § 2º (fork F-g6b-01), § 1º carries no 'neste Capítulo'.

witnesses: cp-g6b-justica-exercicio-arbitrario-a-desobediencia-testes.l4: `a fuga por descuido do vigilante contratado` — the negligent form of § 4º under the taken reading, no crime under the other
notes: For the conductor: at integration this helper can be replaced by g6a's encoding of art. 327, with a cross-check assertion that the two agree on the four `Vínculo` fields.

site.anchor: crime de evasão mediante violência contra a pessoa (art. 352)

source.quote: Art. 352 - Evadir-se ou tentar evadir-se o preso ou o indivíduo submetido a medida de segurança detentiva, usando de violência contra a pessoa:

readings.description: As written: any prisoner who escapes by violence against a person commits it, whether or not the imprisonment was lawful.

citations.cite: CP art. 352 — "o preso", where art. 351 says "legalmente presa"

readings.description: Only a lawfully held prisoner: resisting an unlawful imprisonment is not an offence against the administration of justice, as art. 351 says of the one who frees the prisoner.

taken.rationale: The neighbouring articles are worded differently and the task was to encode each as written. The record carries `o agente estava legalmente preso`, which the rule deliberately does not read, so the difference is visible and tested.

witnesses: cp-g6b-justica-exercicio-arbitrario-a-desobediencia-testes.l4: an unlawfully held prisoner escaping by violence — art. 352 under the taken reading, not under the other

site.anchor: crime de motim de presos (art. 354)

source.quote: Art. 354 - Amotinarem-se presos, perturbando a ordem ou disciplina da prisão:

readings.description: "presos", plural: two or more prisoners rioting together, disturbing the prison's order or discipline.
A riot needs a considerable number of prisoners, enough to be a collective uprising; two is a quarrel, not a motim.

taken.rationale: The only number the text supports is the plural's; a larger one would be invented. The count is an input, so the threshold is one line.

witnesses: cp-g6b-justica-exercicio-arbitrario-a-desobediencia-testes.l4: `motim de 2 presos` — the crime under the taken reading, not (on any plausible threshold) under the other

site.anchor: a segunda figura do art. 358

source.quote: Art. 358 - Impedir, perturbar ou fraudar arrematação judicial; afastar ou procurar afastar concorrente ou licitante, por meio de violência, grave ameaça, fraude ou oferecimento de vantagem:

readings.description: The semicolon ends the first figure: preventing, disturbing or defrauding a judicial auction is the crime by any means; the means qualify only the removal of a competitor.

citations.cite: CP art. 358 — the semicolon after "arrematação judicial"

readings.description: "por meio de violência, grave ameaça, fraude ou oferecimento de vantagem" qualifies both figures.
readings.rejection_rationale: "fraudar" in the first figure already names a means, which would be redundant with "fraude" among the qualifying means; and the semicolon separates two clauses with their own verbs.

taken.rationale: `a primeira figura do art. 358` reads no means; `a segunda figura do art. 358` requires one (tested both ways).

site.anchor: nos dois últimos quadrimestres do último ano do mandato ou legislatura (art. 359-C)

source.quote: Ordenar ou autorizar a assunção de obrigação, nos dois últimos quadrimestres do último ano do mandato ou legislatura,

citations.cite: CP art. 10 — "Contam-se os dias, os meses e os anos pelo calendário comum"

readings.description: The quadrimestre is a division of the financial (calendar) year: the period is 1 May to 31 December of the last financial year that ends within the term — the term's own year if it ends on 31 December, the year before otherwise.

citations.cite: CP art. 359-C — "último ano" beside "o mesmo exercício financeiro" and "o exercício seguinte" in the same sentence

readings.description: The last two four-month periods of the term itself: the eight months that end on its last day, counted by the calendar.

citations.cite: CP art. 359-C — "do último ano do mandato ou legislatura"

taken.rationale: The article turns on the financial year throughout ('no mesmo exercício financeiro', 'no exercício seguinte'), and quadrimestres are how the financial year is divided. Both readings are executable: the exported rule takes the reading as a parameter, TYPICALLY this one.

witnesses: cp-g6b-financas-publicas-testes.l4: a legislature ending on 31.1.2027: 15.5.2026 is in the taken reading only, 15.1.2027 in the other only; the eight months run from 1.6.2026
a President's term ending on 5.1.2031: the eight months run from 6.5.2030, while the taken reading covers 1.5.2030 to 31.12.2030
notes: The readings agree for a term ending on 31 December (1 May to 31 December). From 2027 the President's term ends on 5 January and the Governors' on 6 January, and a legislature ends on 31 January, so they will part in practice. Those dates are from general knowledge, not the source; the tests use them only as cases.
The eight months are counted with cp-pena's `o último dia do prazo` (art. 10), which does not clamp at a month's end (PLAN trap T9).

site.anchor: a despesa não pode ser paga no exercício ou lhe falta contrapartida (art. 359-C)

source.quote: cuja despesa não possa ser paga no mesmo exercício financeiro ou, caso reste parcela a ser paga no exercício seguinte, que não tenha contrapartida suficiente de disponibilidade de caixa:

readings.description: An obligation that is not paid off within the year is a crime unless enough cash covers the part left to the next year: (not payable within the year, or a part left) and no sufficient cash.

citations.cite: CP art. 359-C — "caso reste parcela ... que não tenha contrapartida suficiente"

readings.description: Two separate cases joined by 'ou': an expense not payable within the year, or a part left to the next year without enough cash; either is the crime.

taken.rationale: Under the other reading an obligation that leaves a part to the next year is already 'not payable in the same year', so the clause about cash never decides a case; a reading that gives each clause work is preferred. Both readings are executable, as a parameter of the exported rule.

witnesses: cp-g6b-financas-publicas-testes.l4: `com caixa para a parcela seguinte` — not payable within the year, a part left, enough cash: no crime under the taken reading, the crime under the other

entries.interpretation_field: a leitura dos cento e oitenta dias

site.anchor: nos cento e oitenta dias anteriores ao final do mandato ou da legislatura (art. 359-G)

source.quote: Ordenar, autorizar ou executar ato que acarrete aumento de despesa total com pessoal, nos cento e oitenta dias anteriores ao final do mandato ou da legislatura:

citations.cite: CP art. 10 — "O dia do começo inclui-se no cômputo do prazo"

readings.description: The 180 calendar days that end on the term's last day, which is still before the term's end: the last day and the 179 before it (for a term ending on 31 December, 5 July to 31 December).

citations.cite: CP art. 359-G — "anteriores ao final do mandato": the final is the term's end, after its last day

readings.description: The 180 days before the last day, which is left out (for a term ending on 31 December, 4 July to 30 December).

citations.cite: CP art. 359-G — "anteriores ao final", read as before the last day

taken.rationale: An act on the term's last day is still within the term and before its end; art. 10 counts the first day of a penal period. Both readings are executable, as a parameter of the exported rule.

witnesses: cp-g6b-financas-publicas-testes.l4: a term ending on 31.12.2026: 4.7.2026 is in the second reading only, 31.12.2026 in the taken reading only
notes: Counted with plain date arithmetic. cp-pena's `o último dia do prazo` was not used: it reads a Duração of 180 days as six calendar months (1/30 of a month per day), and from 5.7.2026 ends on 4.1.2027 where 180 calendar days end on 31.12.2026 (asserted in the tests). Reported to the conductor.

entries.delegated_field: `o último dia do mandato ou da legislatura` on the case records of arts. 359-C and 359-G

site.anchor: Fato de assunção de obrigação no último ano do mandato ou legislatura

source.quote: nos cento e oitenta dias anteriores ao final do mandato ou da legislatura:

citations.cite: CP art. 359-C — "do último ano do mandato ou legislatura"

readings.description: The term of the head of the power or entity whose budget the act binds (the mayor's, the legislature's), whoever orders the act.

citations.cite: CP arts. 359-C and 359-G — "do mandato ou legislatura", not "do seu mandato"

readings.description: The agent's own term: only a holder of a mandate, at the end of it, commits these crimes.

taken.rationale: The fact supplier certifies which term the act falls in by giving its last day; the field's herald says 'the term of office or legislature in which the act falls'.

site.anchor: os elementos do art. 337-O estão reunidos

source.quote: Omissão grave de dado ou de informação por projetista

citations.cite: CP art. 337-O, caput — "Omitir, modificar ou entregar à Administração Pública levantamento cadastral ou condição de contorno ... em contratação para a elaboração de projeto básico, projeto executivo ou anteprojeto, em diálogo competitivo ou em procedimento de manifestação de interesse"

readings.description: The preceito names no agent; the crime is anyone's who does the conduct in one of the three contracting contexts, which in practice is the designer or the bidder who supplies the survey.
The heading, part of the enacted text, makes it a crime of the designer (projetista) only.

taken.rationale: The record carries no agent quality; the three contexts are an element (`contratação em que ocorreu`), which confines the crime to the settings where a designer works. A heading is read in construction but does not add an element the preceito lacks.

notes: g6a records a different overlap in the same field: arts. 326 and 335 print the conduct of arts. 337-J, 337-I and 337-K (fork F-g6a-15, taken `vigentesComoImpressos`). g6b's arts. 337-I, 337-J and 337-K are encoded as printed, consistently; integration should see one question there, F-g6a-15, not two.
